name: 72andsunny-the-art-of-deck-making-2020
title: 72andSunny The Art of Deck Making 2020
description: 72andSunny's 2020 guide turns deck design into a craft discipline, arguing that good decks sell ideas through clarity, hierarchy, restraint, and narrative. Built around examples from Super Bowl campaign work and a series of do-and-don't rules, it urges teams to open strong, label clearly, use high-resolution imagery, and treat templates as guidelines rather than constraints.

name: wetransfer-ideas-report-2021
title: WeTransfer Ideas Report 2021
description: WeTransfer Ideas Report 2021 summarizes a global survey of 10,000+ creatives across 135 countries for creative professionals and employers. It finds creative influence decentralizing,Latin America and younger creators taking more risks,while Gen Z faces mental-health and financial pressure, clients prioritize collaboration over ego, and many creatives are leaving unfulfilling roles. Recommendations target brands and employers to support wellbeing, equitable opportunity, and collaborative processes

name: quantum-wellness-spa-brand-guidelines
title: Quantum Wellness Spa Brand Guidelines
description: Brand guidelines for Quantum Wellness Spa, a DTLA hospitality and wellness concept that blends spa, entertainment, and community. The 78-slide deck documents the identity system: wordmark and avatar rules, color palettes and gradients, (Glacial Indifference, Space Mono), Lissajous curves and circular motifs, messaging, audience profiles, and applied mockups for social, merchandise, and stationery

name: ineos-brand-guidelines-2023
title: INEOS Brand Guidelines 2023
description: INEOS Brand Guidelines Version 1 (April 2023) covers the full visual and verbal identity for the global chemicals, manufacturing and energy group across 104 slides. Core assets: the INEOS wordmark in Britannia Blue (PMS 2965C), the 'O' device in full/half/quarter-crop applications, and a directional-line system derived from the 'O' height. Typefaces are Helvetica Neue externally and Arial internally, with a shared hierarchy across overline, headline, subhead, and body. The color palette leads with Britannia Blue and extends to Cerulean, Green, Neon Orange, Neon Yellow, Brigade Red, and Toto Rosso. Grid guidance covers 12-column landscape and portrait systems. Applied chapters cover signage (ground-based, wall-mounted, directional, safety), vehicle livery (bikes, cars, vans, trucks), workwear (helmets, lab coats, overalls), PowerPoint, email signatures, letterheads, news releases, and business cards.

name: highsnobiety-research-report-2020
title: Highsnobiety Research Report 2020
description: Highsnobiety's IN FAKE LIFE (Q3 2020) is a research report on how COVID-19 disrupted the experience economy, drawn from a 652-reader survey (80% aged 18-34; North America 42%, Europe 37%, APAC 14%) and 11 expert interviews. Key findings: 83% shopped as much or more during lockdown; 57% said virtual events can be memorable, but 35% attended none; only 2% prefer socializing online. Work (49%), movies (45%), and shopping (44%) ranked as the most uploadable activities. Spontaneity, mass gatherings, physical touch, and holistic activation stayed largely irreplaceable. Experts include Daniel Arsham, Chris Dercon, Amar Lalvani, and Krissy Jones.

name: asihome-brand-guidelines-2024
title: AsiHome Brand Guidelines 2024
description: AsiHome's 2024 brand guidelines cover the identity system for this home goods brand across 26 slides. The logo appears in primary and dark-background variants with scaling rules. The color system has two primary colors, Jacko Bean and Burnt Crust, plus four secondary tones, Ocean, Lush, Sun, and Sand, with Jacko Bean specified at 45% of usage. The primary typeface is Neue Haas Grotesk, with bold headers and lighter weights for body text. Visual style uses a square motif to frame imagery. Mockup applications include catalogs, business cards, and stationery.

name: dept-impact-report-2023
title: DEPT® Impact Report 2023
description: DEPT®'s 2023 Impact Report covers the global digital agency's ESG performance across client impact, workforce diversity, and climate. Key figures: 11% of revenue from impactful work (target 15% by 2025), 6 Webby Awards and 27 People's Voice nominations, and Agency of the Year recognitions from Digiday, Campaign, and AdAge. On climate, the agency targets a 50% Scope 1 and 2 emissions reduction by 2030 and 90% renewable energy by 2025. Certifications include B Corp, Climate Neutral, and SoDA membership. DEI goals set targets for representation in leadership by 2027. The report uses GRI and SDG frameworks.

name: lululemon-impact-report-2023
title: Lululemon Impact Report 2023
description: Lululemon's Impact Report 2023 covers fiscal-year disclosures (ending Jan 28, 2024) across three pillars: Be Human, Be Well, and Be Planet. On inclusion, store employees reached 41% racial diversity (vs. 31% in 2020) and U.S. pay equity hit 100%. On wellbeing, the Centre for Social Impact reached 7.4 million people with cumulative investment of $44.8M toward a $75M target. On climate, SBTi-validated 2030 targets include a 60% absolute Scope 1 and 2 reduction and a 60% Scope 3 intensity reduction vs. 2018; the company reported a 31% Scope 3 intensity reduction in 2023 and sourced 47% of products from preferred materials. The supplement includes TCFD and SASB/GRI indices and third-party GHG assurance.

name: d-ad-annual-trend-report-2023
title: D&AD Annual Trend Report 2023
description: Cataloguing creative patterns from 12,000 entries and judgments by 300+ jurors, D&AD's Annual Trend Report 2023 synthesizes seven emergent trends and five enduring themes observed across two Black Pencils and 69 Yellow Pencils. The report highlights trends such as Joyful Surrealism, Open-Source Casting, Ownable Iconicity, Preserving the Past, Pay It Forward, Augmentation for All, and early generative AI, and recommends ethical partnerships, rigorous storytelling, and long-term community commitments

name: scania-identity-manual-2017
title: Scania Identity Manual 2017
description: The Scania Identity Manual 2017 covers the full visual and communication system for the Swedish truck and bus manufacturer across 107 slides. Primary assets include the wordmark, the griffin symbol (full-color and monochrome), and vertical and horizontal lock-up logotypes. The custom typeface family Scania Sans has three variants,Headline, Sans, and Condensed,in Bold, Regular, and Italic, with Helvetica Neue and Arial as fallbacks. The brand color system uses Scania Blue, Silver, White, and Red as primaries, with Orange, Beige, Pale Green, and Green as secondaries. The manual covers landscape, portrait, brochure, odd-format, and roll-up grid systems, along with image style principles (natural light, no over-retouching), custom icon sets, and material guidance including the restricted cropped-griffin sticker.

name: reddit-brand-guidelines-2021
title: Reddit Brand Guidelines 2021
description: Reddit Brand Guidelines 2021 covers the platform’s full visual and verbal identity across 54 slides. It specifies Snoo mascot construction (genderless, they/them, blank head on Orangered field), lockup rules for the wordmark, the OrangeRed gradient (67.5°), neutral palette (Beluga through Squid Ink), and extended product tones. Reddit Sans has five weights, true italics, four flavor variants (Vanilla, Chocolate, Strawberry, Fudge), and 67.5° slash letterforms. Voice rules call for casual, community-first copy using platform terminology (redditor, subreddit, karma, AMA). Platform scale boilerplate: 100,000+ communities and 50+ million daily active users.

name: chinatown-brand-guidelines-2022
title: Chinatown Brand Guidelines 2022
description: Chinatown Brand Guidelines (Fall 2022) cover the identity system for the Experience Chinatown project, which directs visitors toward long-standing local businesses to counter the gentrification pressure of Dimes Square. The document covers history, four core values (Support, Equity, Education, Community), a three-color palette (Street Black, Chntwn Red, Stone Beige), the Lucky Knot mark, Motty the Monkey mascot, and Liberation Sans type. Touch points include a four-step app flow (Scan, Inform, Choose, Experience), posters, stickers, animations, and confetti.

name: space10-exhibition-catalogue
title: SPACE10 Exhibition Catalogue
description: SPACE10's 2023 Exhibition Catalogue gives galleries and exhibitors free access to assets from seven research and design projects produced at the IKEA-backed lab in Copenhagen. The seven projects are Bee Home, SolarVille, The Growroom, Spaces on Wheels, Future Food Today, Tomorrow's Meatball, and Urban Village. Each entry includes print-ready images, descriptions, GIFs, and installation guidelines; Bee Home and The Growroom also include open-source build manuals. SPACE10 requires credit in all exhibitions and asks partners to uphold its principles on sustainability, accessibility, and diversity.

name: patagonia-impact-report-2025
title: Patagonia Impact Report 2025
description: Patagonia's Work in Progress 2025 Impact Report covers governance, supply-chain commitments, and environmental performance for fiscal 2025. The report documents the 2022 ownership restructure into the Patagonia Purpose Trust and Holdfast Collective, FY2025 emissions of 182,646 MT CO2e and revenue of $1.47B, $14.7M in grants via 1% for the Planet, PFAS-elimination progress, living-wage milestones across 89,806 supply-chain workers, and a materials improvement trajectory reaching 84.1% desirable fibers.

name: zalando-sustainability-progress-report-2022
title: Zalando Sustainability Progress Report 2022
description: Zalando's Sustainability Progress Report 2022 tracks FY2022 performance against its do.MORE strategy across Planet, Products, and People. Key results: 78% Scope 1 and 2 emissions reduction vs 2017, 62,000 metric tons of packaging used (86% recycled, 5.1 g single-use plastic per item), 17% of GMV from sustainable products, 5,016 people reached by skilling programs, and 154 brand assessments covering 67% of net merchandise value. The report includes GRI and SASB annexes.

name: openai-brand-guidelines-2022
title: OpenAI Brand Guidelines 2022
description: OpenAI's 2022 brand guidelines (v1.0.1, prepared by AREA 17) cover logo usage, lockups, and clear space rules for a primary black-and-white identity with saturated RGB accents. The document specifies two typefaces, Signifier serif and Söhne sans, along with the iconography grid, stroke weights, photography direction (warm, film grain, DALL-E as a fallback), and detailed data-visualization rules covering WCAG contrast, chart spacing, and series limits.

name: stoneco-investor-day-2023
title: StoneCo Investor Day 2023
description: StoneCo's Investor Day 2023 is a 354-slide investor presentation laying out three strategic priorities: win the Brazilian MSMB market, drive product engagement, and scale through a unified tech platform with distribution reach across over 99% of Brazil's GDP. The deck ties together product bundling across payments, banking, software, and credit, and closes with 2024-2027 targets: MSMB TPV above R$600bn, client deposits above R$14bn, and adjusted net income above R$4.3bn.

name: it-s-nice-that-creative-community-survey-2021
title: It's Nice That Creative Community Survey 2021
description: It's Nice That's Creative Community Survey 2021 draws on responses from its 2M+ monthly audience to map demographics, interests, and media habits. Key numbers: 70% are 18-34, 90% hold a degree, 80% back eco-conscious brands, 88% prioritise Instagram, and 70% visit the site for creative industry news. The deck is pitched as a partnership sales tool and closes with a curated inspiration directory of audience-favourite tech and fashion brands.

name: accept-proceed-impact-report-2020-2022
title: Accept & Proceed Impact Report 2020–2022
description: Accept & Proceed's 2020–2022 Impact Report covers the London B Corp studio's work across governance, team, community, environment, and customers. The studio scored 83.6 on its B Impact Assessment and modeled a path to 94.4, logged 3,700+ pro-bono hours with partners 20/20 Change and MaadTechy, and set a target of at least 25% GHG reduction by 2021/22 with full net-zero by 2027.

name: pangaia-impact-report-2021
title: PANGAIA Impact Report 2021
description: PANGAIA Impact Report 2021 is the company's annual sustainability report for stakeholders, summarizing progress across Planet, People, Innovative Materials, Systems, and Giving Back. It argues PANGAIA is scaling science-led material innovation, supply-chain transparency, and regenerative sourcing to reduce impacts,setting targets including halving emissions by 2030 and achieving net-zero (scope 1–3) by 2040

name: future-snoops-trend-report-2026
title: Future Snoops Trend Report 2026
description: Future Snoops' 2026 home and lifestyle trend report covers three macro trends, 'Casual Comfort', 'Rerooted', and 'Redefining Formal Kitchens', tracing how consumers are gravitating toward flexible, nature-connected, and multifunctional living spaces. The report tracks the growth of direct-to-consumer models, resilience as a design principle, and specific product and material shifts reshaping how people live, host, and work at home.

name: byd-service-visual-identification-system-2023
title: BYD Service Visual Identification System 2023
description: Brand guidelines for BYD Service's overseas after-sales centers, documenting the visual identification system and application rules for signage, environmental graphics, uniforms, stationery, and workshop fit-out. The deck specifies exact color values (Festival Red Pantone 199C, Cool Gray variants), (Source Sans Pro), dimensions and materials for storefronts, floor markings, signage types, service kits, and vehicle decals. Intended for regional facilities, contractors, and brand managers; 47 slides

name: highsnobiety-bcg-research-report-2023
title: Highsnobiety & BCG Research Report 2023
description: Research report by Highsnobiety and BCG presenting a March 2023 pulse check of luxury consumers. It argues 'The New Luxury', where cultural participation, community, and experiences trump pure possession, is reshaping demand, supported by two surveys (total n≈9,262 across US/UK/FR/DE) and a 566-person Cultural Pioneers panel. Gen Z/Millennials are set to drive roughly 75% of personal luxury by 2026 and the true-luxury market is estimated at €550–560 billion, with China as the leading growth driver.

name: vice-media-group-youth-census-2022
title: Vice Media Group Youth Census 2022
description: Vice Media Group Youth Census 2022 is a global research report based on an online survey of 22,602 respondents across North America, LATAM, EMEA, MENA, and APAC. It argues identity is shaped more by personality, values, and family than demographics, catalogs seven cultural passion points (music, gaming, food, beauty, fashion, finance, travel), and documents regional resource gaps, particularly in India and Indonesia where young people report the largest unmet needs.

name: frontify-the-creative-2024
title: Frontify The Creative 2024
description: Frontify's Creative Director's Checklist, developed with D&AD, addresses the organizational obstacles that block creative work. It presents a six-step framework for maintaining creative control through centralized brand management, and draws on a survey of creative directors to document how time pressure and collaboration friction erode creative output. The deck argues that a digital brand hub removes those barriers and positions creative directors as strategic operators rather than production managers.

name: klarna-visual-identity-guidelines-2019
title: Klarna Visual Identity Guidelines 2019
description: Brand guidelines for Klarna that document rules for logo and lockups, Klarna Headline and Klarna Text, the core colour system centered on Klarna Pink, and the 'Smoooth' tonal model across four marketing stages (Disrupt, Attract, Engage, Join). The 81-slide guide covers trademark rules, system grids, imagery treatments, packaging mockups, and asset distribution via the Locker DAM

name: neuroaesthetics-design-for-the-mind
title: Neuroaesthetics: Design for the Mind
description: Design Hotels' research report examines neuroaesthetics and how design shapes cognition, emotion, and wellbeing, synthesizing 108 academic citations, five expert interviews, and a June 2023 survey of 1,789 community members. It argues that architecture, materiality, and multisensory tools (mobile EEG, biosensors, scent strategies, VR, and biophilic design) can be intentionally deployed to foster belonging, community, psychological transformation, and longevity

name: popeyes-brand-guidelines-2019
title: Popeyes Brand Guidelines 2019
description: Popeyes Brand Guidelines 2019 is a 105‑slide brand manual for designers, marketers, and franchise partners that codifies visual identity, tone, and applications. It defines core assets, the POPEYES® wordmark and seal, Chicken Sans typeface, POPEYES Orange palette, Poppy character, and a Louisiana‑inspired pattern, and prescribes logo use, photography, packaging, uniforms, and OOH executions for consistent global implementation

name: the-projects-a-2020
title: The Projects A 2020
description: The Projects' 2020 culture guide maps the post-pandemic paradigm shifts that changed consumer behavior and industry trajectories. It traces transitions from busyness to introspection, from optimization to integration, and from work-life balance to personal work-life boundaries. The report covers the rise of counsel culture, technology's effect on daily routines, and the direction of fashion, retail, and travel as sustainability, community, and individual autonomy became organizing principles.

name: state-of-ai-in-design-2025
title: State of AI in Design 2025
description: Foundation Capital and Designer Fund's State of AI in Design 2025 surveys how AI is reshaping the design profession, covering where AI fits across the design process, adoption rates among practitioners and teams, and the advantages AI-native companies hold over traditional design orgs. The report argues that human creativity remains the differentiating factor and lays out specific strategies for designers and design leaders to stay competitive as AI tools mature.

name: kpr-brand-book-2022
title: KPR Brand Book 2022
description: KPR Brand Book 2022 documents identity guidelines for KPR, a Web3 worldbuilding project that turns digital collectibles and avatars into shared physical and virtual experiences. It defines logo systems, a primary black/white/purple palette, three typefaces (Whyte Inktrap, IBM Plex Mono, Hexaframe CF), repeatable patterns (Computer Chip, Grid), and six sub-brands (Animus, Prisma, KPCO, Boon, Neon, KLMX). Includes application mockups and contact at laffy@kprverse.com

name: building-a-brand-like-patagonia
title: Building a Brand Like Patagonia
description: Nayture's report uses Patagonia as a case study for sustainable brand building, structured around the Green Brand Code's eight elements. It covers Patagonia's anti-consumerism positioning, environmental activism, and the specific practices that shaped its brand perception, then maps those to a consulting framework brands can apply when integrating sustainability into their core strategy.

name: next-culture-guide-2022
title: Next Culture Guide 2022
description: Internal culture guide for Next (Next Insurance) for employees and new hires that centers the company on serving small-business owners and the self‑employed. It links four core values,Phenomenal Service; Be Unstoppable; Dare to Simplify; Play as a Team,to concrete practices such as running like small businesses, launching small experiments, prioritizing customer outcomes, and simplifying processes. The guide uses customer vignettes and market stats (30M U.S. owners; 50% five‑year failure) for context

name: vml-intelligence-the-future-100-trends-change-to-watch-in-2025
title: VML Intelligence The Future 100: Trends & Change to Watch in 2025
description: VML Intelligence's The Future 100 maps 100 trends across 10 sectors for 2025: culture, technology, travel, food and drink, beauty, retail, luxury, health, work, and brands. Each trend entry combines consumer data, brand case studies, and forward-looking indicators, covering topics from generative AI adoption and spatial computing to wellness rituals, sustainability packaging, and shifting consumer identity. The 271-slide report is structured as a reference toolkit for brand strategists and planners looking to track change across industries simultaneously.

name: google-cloud-ai-business-trends-2025
title: Google Cloud: AI Business Trends 2025
description: Research report from Google Cloud for enterprise leaders, synthesizing a 2,500-respondent survey, The ROI of Gen AI study, and product signals from Gemini and NotebookLM to distill five strategic AI trends for 2025. It argues multimodal AI, agentic systems, assistive enterprise search, AI-powered customer experience, and AI-driven security are near-term priorities, citing market forecasts (~$2.4B multimodal in 2025; $12.9B enterprise search by 2031) and adoption indicators (10% agent use; 82% planning)

name: palantir-q1-2025-investor-update
title: Palantir Q1 2025 Investor Update
description: Palantir's Q1 2025 investor update reports $628 million in total revenue, up 39% year-over-year, with US revenue growing 55% and US commercial revenue up 71%. The deck covers the Palantir Degree fellowship launch, TITAN deliveries to the U.S. Army, the Maven Smart System for NATO, and the Warp Speed manufacturing platform. Financial metrics include a 20% GAAP operating margin, $391 million adjusted operating income at a 44% margin, Rule of 40 at 83%, $5.4 billion in cash with no debt, and 139 deals closed above $1 million. Q2 2025 guidance is $934–938 million; full-year guidance is $3.890–3.902 billion.

name: cnvrt-labs-growth-report
title: Cnvrt Labs Growth Report
description: Cnvrt Labs' growth report covers its design work for growth-stage startups and Fortune 500 companies, with a focus on marketing websites and brand systems. The 26-slide deck outlines a methodology that merges psychology, marketing strategy, and visual design, and documents client outcomes including $100 million raised and 8.5 million monthly visitors generated for clients.

name: dept-trends-2025
title: DEPT. Trends 2025
description: DEPT. Trends 2025 is a 58-slide trends report for CMOs, product leaders, and data teams arguing that rapid, AI-driven change rewards organizations prioritizing speed, experimentation, and proprietary data. It maps four provocations,from AI's "10% realized" value claim and the need for modern data foundations to hyper-personalization in adtech, conversational search and shopping assistants, ethics (EU AI Act) and workforce augmentation, plus healthcare and climate use cases

name: d-ad-insight-report-2020
title: D&AD Insight Report 2020
description: D&AD Insight Report 2020, Now and Next is a trend report for creative leaders and agencies synthesising award-winning work, festival discussions, and cultural analysis to map where creativity is shifting. It argues four themes,Repetition & Originality, Redefining Representation, Challenging Visual Bias, and New Values of Creativity,show how tools, sensory formats, and regulation reshape practice. The report draws on ~25,000 entries, 718 Pencil winners, and a collaboration with Flamingo to recommend hiring, inclusive tools, and multisensory experimentation

name: m-rning-report-2025
title: MØRNING Report 2025
description: Research report by MØRNING for brands and cultural strategists that argues the fake/real binary is broken and proposes 'Meta‑Fantasy' as a constructive cultural mode. It maps four adopted coping modes, identity fragmentation, and AI's role in creativity, then offers a four‑point brand roadmap to move from performative purpose to multiverse storytelling. Findings derive from digital ethnography, social listening, workshops and interviews across LA, NY, London, Berlin and Shanghai

name: zip-brand-guidelines
title: Zip Brand Guidelines
description: Brand guidelines and merchant marketing toolkit for Zip, a buy-now-pay-later provider. The deck covers logo usage rules, clear space and minimum size specs, six checkout button variants, the core color palette, and Cooper BT Light / Sharp Grotesk typography. It then walks merchants through on-site placements, topstrip banners, evergreen banners, product-page installment widgets, cart widgets, information modals, and checkout radio buttons, to drive adoption of Zip's pay-in-four option.

name: wkshps-identity-concept-for-active-cultures-2018
title: Wkshps Identity Concept for Active Cultures 2018
description: Identity concept by Wkshps for Active Cultures, a Los Angeles cultural venue blending art exhibitions, film screenings, and dining. The deck develops a custom logotype from GT Super Display and Styrene B, derives an abstract icon system from letterform details, and establishes an eight-color palette. Mockups span exhibition posters, event announcements, dining collateral, stationery, and street poster campaigns for the September 2018 opening at 1811 E 20 Street.

name: satrio-arkan-portfolio-2022
title: Satrio Arkan Portfolio 2022
description: Graphic design portfolio by Indonesian designer Satrio Arkan showcasing brand identity, campaign, editorial, and event work. The 40-slide collection documents identity systems, color and type specs, brochures, posters, packaging, and promotional campaigns for clients including Peregrine Studios, Bangsa Mahardika, JHL Collections, Ziato Gelato, Beetleflux, Pattero, and (P)ronounce (2021–2022)

name: futerra-the-awesome-anthropocene-goals
title: Futerra: The Awesome Anthropocene Goals
description: Research report from Futerra proposing the Awesome Anthropocene Goals: 20 ambitious, 2050-oriented visions that extend and reframe the 2030 SDGs across health, energy, equality, ecosystems, infrastructure and governance. The report maps each SDG to a bold 2050 goal, compiles evidence and signals of feasibility, and offers starter actions for businesses, policymakers and individuals. It also proposes three new goals, gender/sexuality as joy, space as commons, and life-first AI, and outlines next steps for public engagement

name: perplexity-ads-pitch-deck
title: Perplexity Ads Pitch Deck
description: Sales deck for Perplexity Ads, the company's advertising product that reaches users during answer-first, AI-powered search moments. It details ad formats,answer-page takeover, sponsored related questions, branded explanatory blurbs, Pro Search placements,alongside brand-safety controls and reporting. The deck cites 230M monthly users and 8x U.S. query growth, and invites charter partners for a Q4 launch with exclusive category ownership

name: palantir-q4-2023-business-update
title: Palantir Q4 2023 Business Update
description: Palantir's Q4 2023 business update reports Q4 revenue of $608M (+20% YoY), full-year 2023 revenue of $2.23B (+17%), and GAAP net income of $210M for the year, the fifth consecutive quarter of GAAP profitability. US commercial revenue grew 70% YoY in 2023. The deck covers AIP (Artificial Intelligence Platform) adoption through boot camps, partnerships with the Israeli Ministry of Defense and NHS, and 2024 guidance of $2.66–2.68B revenue with adjusted operating income of $868–880M.

name: paris-2024-host-country-usage-guide-2024
title: Paris 2024 Host Country Usage Guide 2024
description: Paris 2024 Host Country Usage Guide (version February 2023) governs how French government entities may use the Olympic and Paralympic emblems. The guide covers the emblem's five constituent elements, the official gold (Pantone 4525) and Olympic black (Pantone 426) palette, Source Sans Pro typography, 20 prohibited logo alterations, protection zones (1X/2X clear space), minimum sizes, and encapsulation rules for color backgrounds. The usage chapter defines six mandatory principles and maps permitted applications (publications, dedicated web pages, temporary displays, sporting venue banners, owned events) against prohibited contexts (correspondence, co-branded stands, unlicensed merchandise). Chapter 3 covers IOC/IPC intellectual property rules and the complete list of protected visual and verbal elements.

name: design-hotels-further-forecast-2025
title: Design Hotels Further Forecast 2025
description: Design Hotels' Further Forecast 2025, Community Capital is a trend report examining how belonging and social ties are reshaping hospitality and travel. It identifies three micro-trends (Niche Appeal, New Knowledge Hubs, Longevity Networks) and uses a 2024 survey (1,196 respondents), expert interviews, and PESTE analysis to recommend hotel programs, partnerships, and experience formats that build lasting community value

name: grafica-italia-2018
title: Grafica Italia 2018
description: Research report summarizing a 2018 survey of 95 Italian graphic design studios (95/189 responses, 50.2%). It profiles studio demographics, education, founding years, staffing (167 men, 166 women), founder gender configurations, service mix (93.6% brand/identity), client sectors (77.8% art & culture), international work (79.8% have non‑Italian clients), teaching activity, and attitudes toward professional recognition and mobility

name: the-future-of-social-dazed-studio-research
title: The Future of Social: Dazed Studio Research
description: Research report from Dazed Studio for brand strategists and cultural teams examining Gen Z and youth social behaviour. Based on a 600-respondent global survey (ages 18–24), seven qualitative interviews, and five expert consultations, it shows TikTok and Instagram dominate attention while young people prioritise wellbeing, authenticity, and private or creator-led spaces. The report surfaces nine emerging patterns and practical implications for brand strategy

name: linear-pitch-deck
title: Linear Pitch Deck
description: Linear's sales deck pitches its issue tracker as a faster Jira alternative for engineering teams. Existing tools are bloated and slow, the argument goes; Linear runs sub-50ms with keyboard-first navigation and native Git, Figma, Notion, and Slack integrations. Over 5,000 customers, including Ramp, Loom, Vercel, and Cash App. Pricing starts free and scales to enterprise with SSO and SCIM.

name: something-else-capabilities-deck-2021
title: Something Else Capabilities Deck 2021
description: Agency capabilities deck for Something Else, a Chicago-based design studio offering twelve disciplines including brand identity, packaging, editorial design, web design, and custom type. The deck showcases projects for clients such as Metric Coffee, Waveplant, Sweet Shot Cookies, Feminist Frequency, Laila Textiles, and Linear Financial Technologies, then outlines a three-phase process from scoping through asset handoff.

name: pleo-brand-guidelines-2020
title: Pleo Brand Guidelines 2020
description: Brand guidelines for Pleo (Version 4.0, Jan 2020) that define voice, strategic positioning, and the full visual system for product and marketing. The deck codifies logo usage, colour palettes, (Neue Haas Grotesk, Spezia), illustration and photography direction, UI palette, and ad/social templates, plus card artwork and merch specs to ensure consistent execution across mobile, web, OOH, and partner co‑branding. Includes asset contact and production notes

name: freepik-brand-guidelines-2023
title: Freepik Brand Guidelines 2023
description: Brand guidelines for Freepik intended for product, marketing, and design partners. The 89-slide guide defines logo systems (including FRPK and isotype rules), the Piki Blue-led color palette, typefaces Degular and Inter, iconography specs, photography and illustration voice, accessibility-tested color pairings, and merchandise rules for consistent application across web, app, and physical touchpoints

name: three-global-brand-guidelines-2025
title: Three Global Brand Guidelines 2025
description: Three's 2025 global brand guidelines codify the brand DNA, logo rules, colour systems, photography, and local delivery requirements for market teams. They specify the purpose 'Born to be better', Helvetica Neue Bold as the core typeface, logo usage and sponsorship variants, naming and sub-brand lock‑ups, and a market-gradient approach to local colour palettes subject to WHAM approval. The deck includes wordmark, store fascia, and photography guidance across 63 slides

name: hudson-valley-house-garden-brand-guidelines-2019
title: Hudson Valley House & Garden Brand Guidelines 2019
description: Hudson Valley House & Garden brand guidelines, designed by Fuzzco in 2019, cover the magazine's full identity system. The primary logo appears in stacked and single-line formats; the brand symbol is a topiary mark with alternate versions for flexible application. Logo clear space is set using the width of the 'H' on three sides. The core color palette uses Field, Black, and White, with each issue's editorial palette drawn from its photography (up to six colors). Typography spans Bold through Light weights. Social avatar specs and do's/don'ts for logo usage are also included.

name: geist-studio-impact-report-2024
title: Geist*Studio Impact Report 2024
description: Geist*Studio Impact Report 2024 summarizes the studio's B Corp accreditation and 2024 performance for clients, partners, and stakeholders. The report pairs a 98.1 B Corp score and category breakdown (Workers 35; Customers 15.5; Community 18.7; Governance 16.9; Environment 11.9) with outcomes: 37 clients supported, 20+ community events, 200+ trees planted with Ecologi, £10,000+ staff training, five pro-bono activations, and seven voluntary partnerships. It closes with 2025 recertification and DEI commitments

name: studio-linear-packages-pricing
title: Studio Linear Packages & Pricing
description: Agency deck for Studio Linear, a woman-owned creative studio specializing in cannabis, CBD, and psychedelic branding. The deck presents tiered pricing for branding, packaging, social media, merch, website, and dispensary design services, then showcases client work for brands like Houseplant, Sweedies, Yummi Karma, and ButACake. It closes with testimonials, press features, and a quarterly pro-bono initiative for BIPOC-owned businesses.

name: fwb-brand-guidelines
title: FWB Brand Guidelines
description: FWB's brand guidelines, produced with CTHDRL, cover the full visual system for the crypto-culture community platform and its FWB.Gallery NFT marketplace. The wordmark pairs TWK Everett (designed by Nolan Paparelli, 2021) with Orpheus Pro Italic, and the logomark's W form mimics bird-head silhouettes with modified curves and removed serifs. The color system uses black as primary and cream for highlights, with outer-glow effects and After Effects displacement maps for digital video. The FWB.Gallery section specifies a three-column, 12-column-sub-grid layout, Place Bid button design, auction interface states, and NFT display flexibility across 3D objects.

name: reece-evans-portfolio
title: Reece Evans Portfolio
description: Portfolio of Reece Evans, a Cambridge-based digital designer and art director specializing in web development, editorial systems, campaign creative, and brand identity. The 43-slide portfolio documents client projects and collaborations (Burberry, Nike, Hypebeast, eBay, Lacoste, Emporio Armani, Audemars Piguet), showing Webflow builds, social-first assets, set and campaign design, and limited-edition activations from 2022–2023. Services foreground craft, responsive experiences, and creative direction

name: northvolt-sustainability-annual-report-2023
title: Northvolt Sustainability Annual Report 2023
description: Northvolt's 2023 Sustainability and Annual Report covers $15 billion in financing secured, a $50 billion order book, and 16 GWh of production capacity across European and North American sites. The 37-slide report details 2023 revenue of $128 million, a workforce of 5,860 employees, and the launch of Northvolt Six. The 2030 targets are specific: 10 kg CO2e/kWh for lithium-ion NMC cells, 100% fossil-free energy, 50% recycled cell content, 100% traceability to mine for raw materials, a lost-time injury frequency rate below 2.0, and a 40% female workforce. The report also covers the three-chemistry cell portfolio (lithium-ion, sodium-ion, lithium-metal), supplier screening, and GRI/UN SDG alignment.

name: apac-beauty-2024
title: APAC Beauty 2024
description: YourStudio's APAC Beauty 2024 deck maps the Asia-Pacific beauty market, where APAC accounts for roughly 50% of global beauty and health spend and premium beauty is growing at 8% annually. The report covers five consumer priorities: personalization, transparency, inclusivity, experience, and innovation. It then translates these into three retail archetypes: next-gen labs (science-led spaces like Ya-Man Tokyo and SKINLALA Beijing), micro-local spaces (culturally rooted formats like Harmay Chengdu and Aesop Hong Kong), and beauty escapes (experiential concepts like Innisfree Seoul and Weirdo Beauty Hong Kong).

name: ilovecreatives-creative-copywriter-course
title: iLoveCreatives Creative Copywriter Course
description: Sales deck for iLoveCreatives' Creative Copywriter Course, taught by Tasha Young. The course spans three sections: copywriting fundamentals, portfolio building, and freelancing, with leveled modules covering tone of voice, SEO, brand strategy, rate-setting, and client pitching. Included resources are a portfolio builder, creative process workbook, resource library, and Discord community. The deck targets aspiring freelance copywriters looking to build a portfolio and land clients.

name: lefty-a-year-in-data-2024
title: Lefty A Year in Data 2024
description: Lefty's A Year in Data 2024 tracks influencer marketing EMV across fashion, beauty, sportswear, hospitality, and automotive. The Paris 2024 Olympics generated 43 billion impressions across 59,000 tracked posts and 6,200 athletes, with artistic gymnastics topping EMV at $113M. Rare Beauty led makeup at $282M EMV, La Roche-Posay broke out in skincare, and Dior and Maison Margiela dominated fashion week. The report closes with ranked lists of the top fashion, beauty, athlete, and emerging influencers of the year.

name: polestar-investor-update-2023
title: Polestar Investor Update 2023
description: Polestar's investor update for the nine months ended September 30, 2023 covers 41,817 deliveries (up 37% YoY), $1.84B revenue, and $951M cash. Q3 alone saw 13,976 deliveries (+51% YoY) and $4M gross profit. The strengthened business plan targets 155–165k vehicles by 2025, high-teens gross margins, and requires approximately $1.3B in additional external funding. The deck covers a six-model product roadmap (Polestar 1–6), asset-light partnership model with Volvo Cars and Geely, 2023 delivery guidance of ~60k units, and GAAP-to-non-GAAP reconciliation.

name: wix-company-overview-q1-2025
title: Wix Company Overview Q1 2025
description: Wix's Q1 2025 company overview for investors covers 288M registered users, Q1'25 revenue of $474M, and Creative Subscriptions ARR of $1.37B. Partners revenue reached $172M (+24% YoY) and transaction revenue hit $59M (+19% YoY). The deck details 2025 guidance of $1.97–2.00B revenue and $2.025–2.060B bookings, a projected free cash flow margin of ~30–31%, and a Rule-of-40 target of 42–45%. TROI cohort analysis, net revenue retention of +106%, and GAAP-to-non-GAAP reconciliation tables complete the financial package.

name: wrkout-brand-guidelines-2020
title: WRKOUT Brand Guidelines 2020
description: WRKOUT Brand Guidelines v3.0 is the identity manual for the WRKOUT fitness platform, written for in-house designers, agencies, and brand partners. It covers the wordmark origin (Orbitron Extrabold with a custom stylized K), logomark construction (the K glyph merged with the kanji for 'person'), Futura PT weights, Warm Pink with Cool and Warm gradient systems, neon-lit photography direction, logomark-derived patterns, social media avatar specs, App Store and Google Play assets, Smart TV tile guidance, and co-brand lockups with Nike, lululemon, Hyperice, Spotify, WHOOP, Onnit, ŌURA, Reigning Champ, AthleticGreens, and Stadia Ventures.

name: tiktok-what-s-next-trend-report-2025
title: TikTok What's Next Trend Report 2025
description: TikTok's What's Next 2025 Trend Report, produced with Brand Chem, draws on TikTok Marketing Science data spanning 2022 to 2024 to map three major forces: Brand Fusion (brands becoming more responsive and community-led), Identity Osmosis (consumer values reshaping brand identity), and Creative Catalysts (AI tools and remix culture lowering production barriers). Case studies cover Western Union's 70% lower CPI through TikTok Creative Exchange, Meoky's 1.8x purchase lift via Symphony Creative Studio, and VietJet's AI avatar expansion.

name: yourstudio-generation-alpha
title: YourStudio: Generation Alpha
description: YourStudio's Generation Alpha report tracks how this cohort, projected to exceed 2 billion by 2025 with a $5.46 trillion economic footprint, is already reshaping consumer markets. Born into AI, metaverse, and crypto as defaults, Gen Alpha carries five defining traits: Digitally Empowered, Active Advocates, Hyper Expressive, Knowledge Seekers, and Balance Conscious. Brands covered include Lego, Fortnite, Allkinds, Evereden, NatWest Rooster Money, Little Loop, and Whirli.

name: wepresent-new-rules-2024
title: WePresent: New Rules 2024
description: WePresent's New Rules (2024) is an 80-slide editorial issue for photographers, editors, and cultural producers exploring photography's current 'unfixed' moment. Organized into four chapters: Taking Risks, Radical Storytelling, Building Community, and Creative Autonomy. Contributors include Charlie Engman, Rhiannon Adam, Quil Lemons, Sheida Soleimani, and guest editor Gem Fletcher, arguing that hybrid practices and collective infrastructure are reshaping the field.

name: it-s-nice-that-adobe-3d-trends-report
title: It's Nice That × Adobe 3D Trends Report
description: It's Nice That and Adobe's 3D Trends Report surveys the creative directions shaping 3D design. The 24-slide report identifies four sub-trends under 'Reimagining Reality': surreal objects, uncanny avatars, hyper-real textures, and organic forms. It profiles Dada Projects founder Christina Worner and spotlights Adobe Substance 3D's five-app pipeline. Emerging directions include playfulness, scientific visualisation, and maximalism.

name: wear-good-shoes-advice-from-magnum-photographers
title: Wear Good Shoes: Advice from Magnum Photographers
description: Magnum Photos' Wear Good Shoes collects career-focused advice and portfolio examples for street, documentary, and personal photographers. The 69-slide guide organizes lessons into five sections: Learn; Vision & Voice; Passion; Consistency; Risk. It draws practical tips from Magnum photographers including De Keyzer, Parr, and Gilden, and promotes The Art of Street Photography, a ten-lesson online course led by seven photographers.

name: the-open-application-network-brand-guidelines
title: The Open Application Network Brand Guidelines
description: The Open Application Network (OAN) brand guidelines cover logo usage, color palettes, and iconography for consistent visual identity across media. The 27-slide document sets rules for logo applications, color swatches, and typefaces, and connects the identity to OAN's core values of security, connectivity, and fairness in shared digital infrastructure.

name: u-s-army-brand-guidelines-2023
title: U.S. Army Brand Guidelines 2023
description: U.S. Army Brand Guidelines v1.0 (March 2023) is the enterprise identity manual for Army communicators and agencies. The 139-slide manual covers logo lockups, the G.I. typeface, primary palette (Army Black, Army Gold, Army Green), a framing grid, motion toolkit, iconography, and data-visualization styles. Three identity principles (Clear, Confident, Human) run throughout, with WCAG/Section 508 accessibility rules, 'Be All You Can Be' tagline assets, and family-of-brands deployment guidance.

name: oculus-brand-guidelines-v2-0
title: Oculus Brand Guidelines v2.0
description: Oculus brand guidelines v2.0 cover logo usage, color palettes, imagery, and system principles for marketing and product teams. The 136-slide manual includes rules for logo endorsements, color gradients, and display settings, with applied examples across advertising and events.

name: marmalade-brand-guidelines-2025
title: Marmalade Brand Guidelines 2025
description: Marmalade Collective brand guidelines reposition the publisher as a community-first platform centered on Afrocentric experiences. The 48-slide document prescribes a black-and-white foundation with neon accents, a Newsreader headline and Bricolage Grotesque body type system, photography treatments spanning dramatic silhouettes, candid documentary, and motion experiments, plus sub-brand tagging and a staged 2025 rollout.

name: polestar-sustainability-report-2023
title: Polestar Sustainability Report 2023
description: Polestar's 2023 sustainability report covers progress toward climate neutrality by 2040 across circularity, transparent supply chains, and inclusion. The 119-slide report documents emissions reduction results, sustainable materials work, and governance updates, and sets out strategies on ethical business practices, human rights, and diversity.

name: zapier-brand-guide-2022
title: Zapier Brand Guide 2022
description: Zapier Brand Guide 2022 documents the visual and verbal identity for product and marketing teams across 60 slides. It covers belief, mission ('Make automation work for everyone'), persona ('the Wise Mentor'), tagline ('Set your work in motion'), typefaces (Degular, GT Alpina, Inter), and a color system led by Zap Orange, plus photography, logo usage, art library, and partner icon rules.

name: studio-freight-capes-2024
title: Studio Freight Capes 2024
description: Studio Freight's 2024 agency portfolio covers brand, product, and campaign work for mission-driven clients including Easol, Republic, Lunchbox, Evmos, Stord, and Bad Boys. The 56-slide deck pairs strategic design, product UI, and campaign execution to measurable outcomes: Easol scaled from 10 to 90+ employees and closed a pre-emptive $25M Series A; Stord's rebrand accompanied growth toward $200M ARR.

name: hexaware-brand-guidelines-2024
title: Hexaware Brand Guidelines 2024
description: Hexaware brand guidelines (Q1 2024) standardize the wordmark, sub-brand architecture, color palette, imagery, and iconography for global communications. The 57-slide deck prescribes logo lockups, clearspace rules, a primary Manrope type system, and a palette with explicit hex/RGB values. It consolidates 160+ named IPs into three core sub-brands: Amaze, Tensai, and RapidX, with templates for web, decks, white papers, and email signatures.

name: air-brand-guidelines-2025
title: Air Brand Guidelines 2025
description: Air Brand Guidelines 2025 define the 'Space to breathe' identity for product and marketing teams, designers, and content creators. The 55-slide system covers logo treatments and clearspace, a two-layer voice, the Control type family, a black-and-white-rooted palette with Sky blue as the dominant accent, motion and tag systems, and application templates for video, social, OOH, and product UI, with explicit do/don't rules throughout.

name: strava-brand-guidelines-2021
title: Strava Brand Guidelines 2021
description: Strava brand guidelines v2.0 (April 2021) for designers, partners, and product teams. The 101-slide manual establishes a visual and verbal system covering the wordmark and Echelon marks, Strava Orange palette, Maison Neue typeface, photography principles, iconography, badges, and the Spandex product design system with grid, data colors, and component specs. Applied templates cover Dorados, Clubs & Challenges, campaigns (The Last Mile, Give Kudos), influencer merch, and Year in Sport assets.

name: the-state-of-social-rewild-the-web
title: The State of Social: Rewild the Web
description: Morning.'s State of Social report maps today's fragmented social environment and presents 'rewilding' as a playbook for brands and creators. Drawing on digital ethnography, cultural audits, and a global shadow committee, the 75-slide deck identifies algorithmic echo chambers, private 'cosy' communities, and rage-driven attention tactics, then prescribes four rewilding principles with case studies (Jacquemus, Skims, Gentle Monster) and exercises for rebuilding niche cultural infrastructure.

name: alec-soth-photographic-storytelling
title: Alec Soth: Photographic Storytelling
description: Magnum Photos course module on Alec Soth's approach to photographic storytelling. Soth walks through five chapters: intuition, photographic language, emotional motivation, Szarkowski's mirrors-and-windows framework, and equipment choices. Each chapter draws on images from Sleeping by the Mississippi, NIAGARA, Broken Manual, Songbook, and Dog Days, Bogota. The workbook stresses authentic subject matter and the discipline of large-format photography.

name: m-rning-trend-report-2024
title: M-RNING Trend Report 2024
description: M-RNING's 2024 Trend Report, The Age of Relevance, examines how attention, celebrity, and cultural authority are redistributed across platforms and generations. The 83-slide report argues relevance is contested, shaped by viral spectacle, intergenerational nostalgia, and fan-driven 'multiverses'. It presents frameworks (decagon field, three levels of relevance), survey findings including a 41% fandom projection stat, and tactical brand recommendations such as brutalist communication and persona-mapping.

name: strava-year-in-sport-2021
title: Strava Year in Sport 2021
description: Strava's Year in Sport 2021 covers global athletic activity trends across 95 million athletes. Activity uploads rose 38% to 1.8 billion. The report tracks walking's growing share across age groups and markets, quantifies the effect of nine extreme weather events on outdoor exercise, and covers community engagement through challenges, clubs, and cross-border kudos networks.

name: mailchimp-small-business-marketing-report
title: Mailchimp Small Business Marketing Report
description: Mailchimp and Hall & Partners research report on why small businesses should start marketing from day one. Drawing on a survey of 505 entrepreneurs, it maps key growth milestones, customer acquisition strategies, and the role of marketing tools. The report gives practical recommendations for overcoming early-stage uncertainty and building momentum.

name: selfridges-project-earth-report-2023
title: Selfridges Project Earth Report 2023
description: Selfridges' Project Earth 2023 report tracks year-on-year progress across Materials, Models, Mindsets, and Net-Zero. Targets include 45% circular transactions by 2030 and net-zero by 2040. Key 2022 outcomes: 17% reduction in Scope 1 & 2 emissions vs 2018, Project Earth Edit labelling 20,607 products (revenue up £72m to £104m), Reselfridges resale exceeding £13m, and Naked Click & Collect saving 39,210 boxes and 7.7t CO2.

name: united-arrows-integrated-report-2023
title: United Arrows Integrated Report 2023
description: United Arrows Ltd.'s 2023 Integrated Report covers corporate strategy, governance, and stakeholder commitments. The 'Beautiful company' long-term vision runs to 2032, backed by medium-term financial targets for 2023–2025 (sales ¥1,600–1,700B; operating profit ¥90–100B; ROE 13.8–15.4%) and investment in OMO, store renewal, and overseas expansion. The SARROWS sustainability program covers circularity, carbon-neutrality, and human rights with SBT recognition.

name: snapchat-friendship-report-2019
title: Snapchat Friendship Report 2019
description: Snapchat's 2019 Friendship Report summarizes a 10,000-person survey across nine countries and four generations on how people form and maintain friendships. Gen Z favors smaller, private networks and nonverbal media (photos, video, emojis). Key numbers: average best-friend age 21; 40% report romantic-like intimacy. The report also covers platform differences and cross-cultural findings, with field photography and expert commentary.

name: roblox-fashion-beauty-trends-2025
title: Roblox Fashion & Beauty Trends 2025
description: Roblox's Fashion & Beauty Trends 2025 report shows how Gen Z uses avatars, digital fashion, and sensory shopping to express identity and influence real-world style. The 30-slide deck combines a 1,500-person U.S./UK survey with platform data: 70.2M daily users, 165 billion avatar updates, and about 1.6 billion digital fashion purchases in 2023. The argument is that avatar customization drives commerce, mental well-being, creator opportunity, and brand partnerships.

name: highsnobiety-the-immunized-shopper-2020
title: Highsnobiety: The Immunized Shopper 2020
description: Highsnobiety's Q1 2020 whitepaper surveys 400 readers to define the Immunized Shopper, a post-quarantine consumer archetype that rejects logomania and hype in favor of quality, minimalism, and brand transparency. The report finds 54% aversion to large logos, 43% planning to spend more on education, and 99% expressing optimism. The central argument: COVID-19 will permanently rescramble luxury desirability rather than repeat the 2008 recession's heritage retreat.

name: league-of-legends-vfx-guide-2017
title: League of Legends VFX Guide 2017
description: Riot Games' 2017 League of Legends VFX guide codifies style, readability, and technical rules for in-game effects. The 37-slide handbook argues VFX must prioritize gameplay clarity through accurate AoE and hitbox representation, value and saturation ranges, shape language, and timing stages. Six sections, Overview, Gameplay, Value, Color, Shapes, Timing, include champion examples for Teemo, Lux, Ziggs, and Sion.

name: overcommitted-report-2024
title: Overcommitted Report 2024
description: Superside's Overcommitted Report 2024 examines the pressures on in-house creative teams: overcommitment, burnout, and resource constraints. The 38-slide report looks at AI's role in improving efficiency and design quality, and offers recommendations for AI adoption, agency partnerships, and sustaining creativity in corporate environments. Insights come from creative leaders and case studies at Palo Alto Networks and Reddit.

name: gharage-airport-futures-2024
title: Gharage Airport Futures 2024
description: Gharage's Airport Futures 2024 report for airport operators, designers, and planners examines how emotion-centred design can improve passenger well-being and commercial performance. The research combines expert interviews, a 6,000-person online survey across 12 countries, and in-depth traveller interviews to propose 12 strategic opportunities, including sleep pods, biophilic spaces, softer tech, and holistic navigation. The ACI benchmark: a 1% satisfaction gain yields a 1.5% revenue lift.

name: chiquita-brand-typeface-2017
title: Chiquita Brand Typeface 2017
description: Chiquita's 2017 proprietary typeface guidelines, developed with Wieden+Kennedy to reinforce a yellow-first identity and distinct voice. The 63-slide deck covers design criteria (condensed geometry, short ascenders, sticker-derived counters), the proposed working name 'nanners', a five-weight family with display and text styles (Ripe, Green, Peeled), and applied systems for packaging, OOH, editorial, and POS.

name: lululemon-global-wellbeing-report-2024
title: lululemon Global Wellbeing Report 2024
description: The lululemon Global Wellbeing Report 2024 draws on an Edelman DXI survey of 16,000 adults across 15 markets to show that social pressure to 'be well' is tied to stagnant wellbeing and widespread burnout. Key findings: 45% report wellbeing burnout; people feeling pressure are 55% more likely to burn out; those with burnout are 43% more likely to feel pressure.

name: arts-midwest-brand-guidelines-2025
title: Arts Midwest Brand Guidelines 2025
description: Arts Midwest Brand Guidelines 2025 is a 45-slide identity manual for Arts Midwest and its regional partners across nine Midwestern states and Native Nations. The deck covers voice, logo systems (primary and secondary marks), a signature Accent graphic, the 44° Amp Angle, color specifications, and Epilogue and Newsreader typefaces. It closes with sample applications for web, social, print, signage, and merch, plus partner lockup rules.

name: the-realreal-2024-resale-report
title: The RealReal 2024 Resale Report
description: The RealReal's 2024 Resale Report tracks luxury consignment trends across brands, categories, and generations. TikTok, streaming TV revivals, and creative director changes are reshaping demand for fine jewelry, vintage designer fashion, and attainable It bags. Standout data points include Tiffany sales up 55%, vintage Diesel searches up 600%, a shift from streetwear to corporate suiting, and the new 'As Is' category targeting 150,000 items diverted from landfill annually.

name: billion-dollar-boy-creator-era-report-2025
title: Billion Dollar Boy Creator Era Report 2025
description: Billion Dollar Boy's Creator Era Report 2025 analyzes practical opportunities for marketers across commerce, entertainment, and partnerships. The 46-slide report argues creators are evolving into entrepreneurs and media producers, driving creator-led commerce, long-form storytelling, ambassador programs, AI-assisted production, wearables, and B2B influencer strategies. Research is based on Censuswide surveys of 4,008 consumers, 508 creators, and 511 senior marketers (May–June 2024), with case studies including Charli D'Amelio and Versace.

name: digital-voices-the-state-of-influence-2025
title: Digital Voices: The State of Influence 2025
description: Digital Voices' 2025 State of Influence report for marketers and brand strategists argues niche creators, not raw scale, now drive cultural capital and measurable ROI. The 52-slide deck is backed by forecasts (creator economy $480B by 2027), AI adoption data (92% of marketers using AI tools), platform shift data (Gen Z preferring TikTok search, YouTube long-form resurging), and full-funnel measurement frameworks.

name: docusign-brand-identity-guidelines-2024
title: Docusign Brand Identity Guidelines 2024
description: Docusign's Official Brand Identity Guidelines (Version 1, April 11, 2024) for designers, marketers, and product teams. The 102-slide manual covers the 'Bringing Agreements to Life' positioning and 'Dynamic Connection' creative platform, with rules for the Nexus icon, DS Indigo wordmark, color system (Cobalt, Inkwell, Poppy), photography, motion, product imagery, and co-branding lockups.

name: on-impact-progress-report-2024
title: On Impact Progress Report 2024
description: On's Impact Progress Report 2024 covers sustainability performance across climate action, material innovation, circularity, and social impact. Product advances include LightSpray™, Cloudnova 2, and preferred-materials targets; operational moves cover TextileGenesis traceability pilots, Cyclon™ take-back pilots, and supplier coal-phase-out commitments. Key numbers: CHF 2.5M in community grants, 29% preferred materials, and 363,824 tCO2e Scope 3.

name: arthaus-brand-guidelines-2022
title: ARTHAUS Brand Guidelines 2022
description: ARTHAUS brand guidelines (2022) define a flexible, organic visual identity for cultural programming and communications. The manual covers logo lockups (horizontal, vertical, Fundación), safe areas and minimum sizes, a primary beige with eight accent colors, Fixture typeface across display and text scales, photography treatments, modular grids, and application mockups for social, stationery, and events. Authored by BrandCrew.

name: dropbox-q3-2024-financial-results
title: Dropbox Q3 2024 Financial Results
description: Dropbox Q3 2024 investor presentation for analysts and shareholders covering quarterly and annual financial results, product strategy, and capital allocation. Key numbers: $2.54B TTM revenue, 3.0% TTM growth, 83.8% non-GAAP gross margin, 18.24M paying users, and $1.36B liquidity. The deck introduces Dropbox Dash for Business (launched Oct 15, 2024) and covers guidance, buyback progress, and debt maturities.

name: accenture-life-trends-2025
title: Accenture Life Trends 2025
description: Accenture Song's Life Trends 2025 identifies five consumer and technology-driven trends: cost of hesitations, the parent trap, the impatience economy, the dignity of work, and social rewilding. The 93-slide report draws on 50+ design studios, 57 expert interviews, and a 24,295-person online survey across 22 markets, and offers practical recommendations for brands and business leaders.

name: hinge-lgbtqia-d-a-t-e-report-2024
title: Hinge LGBTQIA+ D.A.T.E. Report 2024
description: Hinge's 2024 D.A.T.E. Report translates survey findings into practical dating guidance for LGBTQIA+ daters. The report argues for a 'slowmance' framework built around three stages: Soft Start, Low-Pressure Dates, and Soft Launch. It draws on 14,000+ respondents (April 2024) and surfaces stats including 77% preferring to speak with a partner before posting and 72% valuing conversation for securing second dates.

name: formula-1-brand-guidelines-2018
title: Formula 1 Brand Guidelines 2018
description: Formula 1's 2018 brand guidelines for internal teams, partners, and agencies. The 205-slide deck documents the new F1 mark and logo suite (Standard, Display, Micro), a bespoke Formula 1 typeface, core palette (F1 Warm Red, Carbon Black, Off-White), a 12pt square base grid, container and line devices, graphic patterns, partner lock-ups, Paddock Club treatment, photography direction, and print stocks and finishes.

name: impermaculture-report
title: Impermaculture Report
description: Research report by Dazed and SPACE10 on how 18–24-year-olds define and experience home. Based on a 1,182-respondent global survey, expert panels, and interviews, it argues Gen Z treats home as portable identity, community, and safety rather than fixed property. Key findings include 73% reporting multiple homes, 67% wanting to own a home, bedroom as primary space, and rising privacy and climate concerns.

name: building-a-brand-like-veja
title: Building a Brand Like VEJA
description: Nayture GmbH analyzes VEJA's brand model through its proprietary Green Brand Code, a framework that scores brands on sustainability criteria such as first-mover status, activism, education, and purpose. The deck traces VEJA's ethical sourcing in the Amazon, its no-advertising policy, the Darwin project in Bordeaux, and its partnership with Ateliers Sans Frontières, and extracts takeaways for brands seeking to build around transparency and quality.

name: protein-agency-ownership-dirty-words-3-2022
title: Protein Agency: Ownership (Dirty Words #3) 2022
description: Protein Agency’s ‘Dirty Words #3: Ownership’ is a 2022 research report combining a 550-person global survey (41 countries), expert interviews, and workshop research to examine a crisis in traditional ownership models. The report maps community ownership incentives, evaluates Web3 experiments including Protein’s $PRTN token and seasonal NFT passes, and offers three practical pathways plus readiness questions for brands and organisations exploring shared ownership.

name: nike-empower-creative-guidelines-2021
title: Nike Empower Creative Guidelines 2021
description: Nike's Empower / Play New brand guidelines equip creative teams, agency partners, and city studios to reach Gen Z 'Future Chasers.' The 270-slide playbook covers creative direction and tone ('Ambitious. Vibrant. Confident'), type systems (Migra, Druk, Helvetica), an eight-color Empower palette with hex codes, motion and OOH/retail treatments, and an Empowered Creative Network (ECN) playbook for creator partnerships and production workflows.

name: hcma-brand-guidelines
title: HCMA Brand Guidelines
description: Brand guidelines for HCMA, an interdisciplinary architecture and design practice, for in-house teams and external partners. The 97-slide document covers verbal identity, logo and avatar construction, a 4:3 squircle motif, primary and extended colour palettes, Neue Haas Grotesk and P22 Mackinac type systems, photography categories, graphic patterns, and application templates including letterhead, business cards, and forms. Accessibility, co-branding, and production specs are also included.

name: opera-one-design-guide-2023
title: Opera One Design Guide 2023
description: Opera One's 2023 external design guide documents the browser's refreshed visual identity and implementation rules. It covers logo variants and clear-space, three icon families (Product, Utility, Expressive), a named accent palette with gradients, the Be Vietnam Pro and Space Mono type system, plus UI and outdoor campaign mockups and co-branding lockups. Practical usage ratios, scale rules, and design-team contact info are included.

name: love-impact-report-2023
title: LOVE. Impact Report 2023
description: LOVE. is a UK creative agency that earned B Corp accreditation in November 2022 with an impact score of 85. The report documents scores by category (Workers 76%, Governance 71.2%, Environment 42.5%, Community 34.2%), illustrates impact through a Penfolds sustainable packaging case study, and records £79,530 raised at the Manchester Ball. It closes with 2024 commitments including carbon measurement with Greenly, environmental training, and increased pro-bono work.

name: inside-great-creative-partnerships-superside-2025
title: Inside GREAT Creative Partnerships: Superside 2025
description: Superside research report for marketing and creative leaders, built from interviews with 20+ practitioners at Wistia, Booking.com, Typeform, Twilio, and Superads. It covers ideation, 'doubles' execution, brand foundations, AI-enabled workflows, and measurement as a practical playbook for scaling high-impact creative under tight timelines. Operational tools include tiering models and Custom GPTs; a Forrester TEI study puts the result at $1.1M in improved campaign performance and 94% ROI.

name: upwork-impact-report-2023
title: Upwork Impact Report 2023
description: Upwork's 2023 impact report for investors, partners, and workforce stakeholders. Upwork documents how it expands economic opportunity through platform investments (Upwork Academy, Research Institute, Upwork Foundation), talent services, and governance updates. Key 2023 outcomes include $3.8B in freelancer earnings, 119k Upwork Academy completions, 851k active clients, and 100% matched carbon-free electricity for offices and remote work.

name: walt-disney-world-brand-guidelines-2021
title: Walt Disney World Brand Guidelines 2021
description: Brand guidelines for Walt Disney World's 50th 'The World's Most Magical Celebration', aimed at marketing, merchandising, and in-park teams. The deck codifies the earidescent visual system, logo lockups (including international translations), Posterama 1927 and Harmonia Sans type, Pantone 10128 gold and 280 blue, park-specific textures, photography, copy templates, and clear-space and printing rules.

name: ikea-play-report-2024
title: IKEA Play Report 2024
description: IKEA Play Report 2024 draws on research with 7,000 participants across seven countries to document the role of play in children's mental wellbeing and happiness. The report finds a broad cultural shift toward prioritizing play, but also uncovers access disparities across income groups and geographies. Key claims: children who play more report higher happiness scores; the home is the most common and most important space for play; and parents who play alongside their children see measurable wellbeing benefits. IKEA uses the findings to make the case for designing homes and products around play.

name: palantir-q1-2023-business-update
title: Palantir Q1 2023 Business Update
description: Palantir Q1 2023 business update for investors and analysts, summarizing Q1 financials, product positioning, and appendix reconciliations. The deck reports Q1 revenue of $525M (+18% Y/Y), second consecutive GAAP net income (GAAP EPS $0.01) and first GAAP operating profitability; $2.9B cash and $189M adjusted free cash flow (36% margin). It introduces AIP (AI Platform), details US commercial vs. government growth, and provides Q2/FY2023 guidance

name: soundid-brand-book
title: SoundID Brand Book
description: Brand guidelines for SoundID, intended for designers and product teams, defining logotype, Inter, a black‑anchored palette with single pop accents, imagery, and a 200‑tile 5×5 pattern library. It documents construction and usage rules for the symbol, lockups, patterns, iconography, and merch, and includes SoundID Reference sub‑brand rules, the hearing‑test UX, and calibration hardware photography

name: boardmasters-brand-guidelines-2025
title: Boardmasters Brand Guidelines 2025
description: Brand guidelines for Boardmasters, a surf and music festival held at Fistral Beach and Watergate Bay in Newquay, Cornwall. The deck specifies the wordmark logo, clear-space rules, a twelve-swatch 2025 colour palette, Acumin Pro and September Spirit typefaces, hand-drawn doodle overlays, paper-texture collage effects, ink-stamp illustrations, a flexible grid system, and photography and video treatment standards for all promotional materials

name: mash-brand-guidelines-2023
title: Mash Brand Guidelines 2023
description: Brand guidelines for Mash, a creator monetization platform, covering logo family and clearspace; color palette (Mashgenta, Cool Charcoal, Key Green, Bitcoin Orange); typefaces (Rules and GT Flexa Mono with an 8pt-responsive scale); MidJourney-based comic-book illustration direction; UI components; and templates for web, social, and print. The 62-slide document is intended for product, marketing, and design partners.

name: freitag-impact-report-2022
title: FREITAG Impact Report 2022
description: FREITAG Impact Report 2022, sustainability report for customers, partners, and stakeholders. It publishes a five‑direction Circularity Roadmap (F‑Crew, Products, Operations, Services, Community), documents a Circular Globe score of 600/1000 with an ambition >800 by 2030, sets a 50% CO2 reduction target by 2030 (net‑zero by 2050), and reports operational results including 99% circular product share, 365,005 kg material processed and 7,011 repaired bags

name: bravida-brand-guidelines-2021
title: Bravida Brand Guidelines 2021
description: Brand guidelines for Bravida that specify logo, symbol, color palette, (Inter with Arial fallback), photography, illustration, iconography, motion, and graphic formats. Intended for internal design, marketing, and external suppliers, the 123‑slide manual provides clear‑space rules, PMS/CMYK/RGB/HEX color specs, scales and weights, photography direction for service and installation contexts, vehicle and workwear applications, and motion/animation standards

name: land-of-plenty-the-hospitality-edit
title: Land of Plenty: The Hospitality Edit
description: Report for brand builders and hospitality leaders presenting The Shift: three design-led strategies,grow your local 'culture biome', turn guilty pleasures guilt-free, and give nature a voice,to make hospitality more planet-positive and resilient. It combines case studies (Normal, Yard Sale, Fogo Island Inn), behavioural data (1.8M UK hospitality jobs; consumer sustainability metrics), and a practical Thinking–Saying–Doing framework with 1%er actions for teams and operators

name: virgin-media-brand-guidelines-2020
title: Virgin Media Brand Guidelines 2020
description: Brand guidelines for Virgin Media (September 2020) for internal teams, agencies, and partners. The deck codifies the MOJO tone, bespoke VM Circular type family and a VM Red-led colour system, then defines graphic devices (flares, plectrum patterns, stickers, content frames), photography and illustration styles, iconography, motion/interaction principles, and file-naming/export conventions for campaigns, product and OOH

name: boiler-room-audience-report-2025
title: Boiler Room Audience Report 2025
description: The Boiler Room Audience Report 2025 covers the state of youth culture as seen through Boiler Room's global audience, 8,300 respondents aged 18–34. The report covers community over algorithms, mindfulness and limits on tech use, purposeful spending, and real-world gathering as antidotes to digital fatigue. Key findings: 72% prefer physical events to online ones, 61% actively avoid social media recommendations, and music remains the primary cultural bonding mechanism. Brands are urged to meet this audience through authenticity and community-led spaces rather than traditional digital funnels.

name: ibm-cost-of-a-data-breach-report-2023
title: IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report 2023
description: IBM Security's Cost of a Data Breach Report 2023 benchmarks the financial impact of 553 breaches across 16 countries and 17 industries, offering an evidence base for CISOs and risk teams. It argues the global average breach cost reached USD 4.45M (US USD 9.48M; healthcare USD 10.93M) and links faster detection, security AI/automation, DevSecOps, and IR preparedness to materially lower costs and shorter breach lifecycles

name: anyways-creativity-matters-2024
title: Anyways Creativity Matters 2024
description: Strategy report from Anyways, a London creative agency, on how brands can use creativity to win attention, rebuild trust, and resist cultural homogenization. The deck argues that customer experience, distinctiveness, purposeful action, and sensory storytelling now matter more than efficiency alone. It closes with four provocations for creative teams: think big, surprise the senses, take a stand, and be extraordinary.

name: coldwell-banker-identity-standards-2020
title: Coldwell Banker Identity Standards 2020
description: Coldwell Banker Global Luxury identity standards (September 2020) for brand, marketing, and affiliate teams. The guidelines prescribe logo and logomark variations, strict DBA lockup rules, trademark and legal usage, color systems, photography direction, and production specifications for stationery, signage, social, email, and event collateral. Detailed sizing, safety-space, and print/digital specs ensure consistent luxury positioning across local agent and office applications

name: dept-retail-commerce-insights-2024
title: DEPT® Retail Commerce Insights 2024
description: DEPT® argues that the traditional retail marketing funnel has collapsed into a nonlinear, multi-channel landscape where every touchpoint, from TikTok Shop to in-store showrooms, can trigger discovery, conversion, or loyalty. The report covers owned e-commerce differentiation, physical retail's evolving role, retail media networks projected to hit $85 billion by 2026, and social commerce heading toward $2.9 trillion. Case studies for Patagonia, Barilla, and Peter Thomas Roth illustrate each channel strategy.

name: figma-x-lit-workshop
title: Figma x LiT Workshop
description: Workshop deck for Figma x LiT that teaches designers and developers practical design-to-code workflows using Dev Mode, MCP Server, Make, Code Connect, and VS Code integration. The deck argues that AI-assisted tooling and design-aware code reduce handoff friction, speed prototype validation, and keep implementations aligned with design systems, and includes hands-on demos, annotation best practices, and resource links

name: ikan-brand-guidelines-2023
title: IKAN Brand Guidelines 2023
description: Brand guidelines for IKAN, a workforce mobility company, documenting a 55-slide identity system (November 2023) that defines positioning and verbal identity, a primary horizontal wordmark plus compact 'k' logomark, clearspace and minimum-size rules, and a palette (Sky Blue, Midnight Green, coral accent). It specifies typefaces Space Grotesk, Calluna, and Lexend Deca, and provides templates for banners, social, stationery, and signage

name: gung-ho-trend-report-2025
title: Gung Ho Trend Report 2025
description: Hypercycle is a 2025 handbook from Gung Ho and Geraldine Wharry for creatives, brands, and cultural strategists. It argues that trend-chasing privileges short-term virality over cultural value and prescribes slow forecasting, community-centered cultural strategy, speculative design, and new ethics-and-metrics (e.g., 'trend emissions'). The 88-slide report synthesizes five years of research, 11 expert interviews, and actionable practices for fashion, media, and creative teams

name: discord-brand-guidelines-2021
title: Discord Brand Guidelines 2021
description: Discord Brand Guidelines 2021 is the official identity system for designers, partners, and agencies, defining the logo and mascot (Clyde), wordmark lockups, color palette (Blurple and accents), (Ginto Nord and Whitney), and tone-of-voice. The deck prescribes clear-space, color-pairing, type scales, UI color semantics, and usage rules, then shows applied examples across ads, social, OOH, merchandise, motion, and an asset library with contact details

name: docusign-brand-identity-guidelines-2024
title: DocuSign Brand Identity Guidelines 2024
description: DocuSign Brand Identity Guidelines 2024 is the official identity system for DocuSign's rebrand into Intelligent Agreement Management, providing rules, assets, and governance for product and marketing teams. It documents logo lockups, the Nexus icon, palette and gradients, DS Indigo, pictograms, photography, video/motion, product imagery, co‑branding, and accessibility guidelines. Includes a capitalization update (Docusign) and 102 practical examples

name: studio-freight-capabilities-deck
title: Studio Freight Capabilities Deck
description: Studio Freight capabilities deck showcases the studio's brand, product, experience, and web engineering work through 55 case studies and deliverables. It highlights measurable outcomes,Easol's growth and $25M Series A pre-empt, Lunchbox's contribution to a $50M Series B, Evmos's August 2023 Web3 launch, Stord's logistics rebrand, and a seven-figure Bad Boys merch drop,illustrating end-to-end creative and go-to-market execution

name: soho-house-esg-report-2023
title: Soho House ESG Report 2023
description: Soho House & Co.'s 2023 ESG Report for members, investors and partners summarises FY2023 performance across people, environment and governance and details the House Foundations social programme. It sets 2030 targets,net‑zero ambition, 50% Scope 1/2 reductions, 50% waste reduction and 95% responsible procurement alignment,and highlights 2023 progress including 2,000+ people supported, ~$2M donated and a 5% Scope 1/2 emissions reduction

name: bolt-brand-guidelines-2024
title: Bolt Brand Guidelines 2024
description: Brand guidelines for Bolt, the checkout technology company, covering tone of voice, logo usage, color palette, and type system. The document defines three verbal principles, thoughtfully concise, knowingly playful, comfortably at ease, then specifies the lightning-bolt wordmark, co-branding lockup rules with partners like Stripe and Klarna, a five-color primary palette anchored by Lightning Yellow, and a type system pairing Agrandir Narrow Bold headlines with Inter body copy.

name: frontify-creativity-in-an-ai-world-2024
title: Frontify Creativity in an AI World 2024
description: Frontify and Adweek explore how generative AI is reshaping creativity in branding and marketing through interviews with six industry experts.
