The report examines whether AI acts as a creative partner or replacement, surfacing tensions around idea quality, homogeneous output, regulation, and the irreplaceable role of human judgment. Key findings include that 49.5% of creatives remain unsure of GenAI's greatest opportunity and 38% of freelancers have yet to adopt it.

name: commercial-filmmaking-trend-report-2026
title: Commercial Filmmaking Trend Report 2026
description: The 2026 trend report by Filmsupply and Musicbed covers the visual and music shifts redefining commercial filmmaking. It argues for intentional simplicity, character-driven human stories, and authenticity over production spectacle, and maps music trends including song-as-concept, nostalgic callbacks, solo instrumentation, and jazz dynamics as tools that shape narrative and emotional tone.

name: the-future-of-retail
title: The Future of Retail
description: This editorial deck by Future Snoops maps the transformation of retail across cultural, technological, and emotional dimensions. It covers key themes including Companion Commerce, the 'Me' Marketplace, and the Intention Economy, arguing that AI-enabled personalization and community engagement will define the next era. The deck makes the case for purpose-driven retail strategies that put human interaction ahead of pure transaction, with retail spaces recast as cultural anchors.

name: stills-design-trend-report-2026
title: Stills Design Trend Report 2026
description: Trend report by Stills for brands and agencies mapping photography-led visual directions for 2026 and arguing that texture, personality, and curated imperfection outperform polish. Highlights include Direct Flash, Maximalism, Sensory Storytelling, Grunge, Surrealism, Scrapbook/Scanner, Cyber Goth, and Future Medieval. The deck includes image catalogs, photographer credits, practical usage guidance, and campaign-ready moodboards to help creatives apply each trend

name: foresight-folk-growing-foresight-2024
title: Foresight Folk: Growing Foresight 2024
description: Research report by Foresight Folk (Dec 2024) presenting a survey of practitioners (101 respondents analyzed) on careers, competencies, and learning pathways in futures practice. It argues the field has grown recently,49% newcomers and 84% mid-career transitions,and identifies core competencies (Strategic Foresight 67%, Futures Literacy 66%), skills gaps, and distinct learning needs for Newcomers versus Established professionals

name: republic-of-sabjiwala-brand-guidelines-2024
title: Republic of Sabjiwala Brand Guidelines 2024
description: Brand guidelines for Republic of Sabjiwala (ROS) that define visual and verbal identity, logo system (hexagon 'baat' emblem, monogram, wordmark), type palette (Roqueen, Montagu Slab, Apercu Pro, Yarndings 20), color system, photography, illustration library, packaging taxonomy (regular vs. campaign), uniforms, stationery, and operational assets. Includes 372 practical mockups, sizing specs, and do/don't rules for field application

name: future-of-influence-by-complex-networks
title: Future of Influence by Complex Networks
description: This report by Complex Networks and Collective looks at how influence works in youth culture, arguing that authenticity and trust matter more than raw reach. It identifies new influential archetypes, creators and activists, and examines what brands and individuals can do to drive genuine social change. The report closes with recommendations for building real two-way connections with youth audiences.

name: dept-trends-forecast-2024
title: DEPT. Trends Forecast 2024
description: DEPT. Trends Forecast 2024 is a 71‑slide briefing for brands, designers, and digital teams that frames 2024 around Connection, Creativity, and Culture and five trend domains: AI, Personalization, Tech & Data, Impact, and Looking Ahead. It argues that widespread generative AI, data-first strategies, spatial computing, gaming, and renewed supply‑chain reshoring will reshape marketing and product, and urges investment in transparent AI, modern data foundations, and accessible design

name: tramways-coffee-brand-guidelines-2022
title: Tramways Coffee Brand Guidelines 2022
description: Brand guidelines for Tramways Coffee (2022) for product, packaging, and marketing teams. The deck documents the verbal hook "Pause to Brew / Brew to Pause", wordmark and symbol rules, a two-tone packaging system (PANTONE 115 C and 298 C), typefaces (All Round Gothic, Basic Gothic Pro), and a standardized sticker system carrying roast, estate, varietal and brewing icons across pack sizes. Founders Sonali and Devansh and design credit to StudioPingPong are noted

name: matter-insurance-brand-guidelines-2023
title: Matter Insurance Brand Guidelines 2023
description: Matter Insurance's 2023 brand guidelines detail the visual identity and design principles, including logo usage, color palette, and application across media. The guide emphasizes the brand's commitment to protection, showcasing elements like custom logotype, brand tape, and social media creatives. Designed by StudioPingPong, it ensures consistent representation of Matter's protective theme

name: the-state-of-youth-vice-youth-census-2022
title: The State of Youth: VICE Youth Census 2022
description: VICE Media Group's The State of Youth: VICE Youth Census 2022 is a global mixed-method study (N=22,602) examining youth identity, wellbeing, and cultural trends across music, gaming, food, beauty, fashion, finance, and travel. Key findings: identity is driven by values not demographics; global concern rose to 81% (2018–2022); participatory behaviors and creator economies are growing, with regional resource gaps in India and Indonesia

name: bb-agency-company-deck
title: BB Agency Company Deck
description: Company presentation for BB Agency, a remote-first creative and engineering firm offering brand, product, and web development services to startups and enterprise clients. The deck outlines BB’s full-cycle workflow,research, brand strategy, UX/UI, and engineering,and illustrates outcomes through case studies for ThoughtSpot, ShipBob, Enode, and CVMaker. Highlights include founding year (2012), 40+ staff, 500+ projects, and client funding of $2.68B

name: lululemon-impact-report-2022
title: Lululemon Impact Report 2022
description: Lululemon Impact Report 2022 summarizes the company's Impact Agenda across three pillars,Be Human, Be Well, Be Planet,and 16 measurable goals covering inclusion, wellbeing, climate, materials, and circularity. The report documents 2022 outcomes (34,000+ employees; ~300,000 makers; US$10M in social contributions; 100% renewable electricity in owned facilities), SBTi-aligned 2030 targets, a 1.2M tCO2e Scope 1–3 footprint, and progress on preferred materials and circular guest models

name: upwork-impact-report-2024
title: Upwork Impact Report 2024
description: Upwork Impact Report 2024 documents the company’s social, environmental, and workforce performance for investors, customers, and partners. It argues that Upwork advances economic opportunity through its global talent marketplace and Mindful AI governance, detailing outcomes such as $769.3M revenue, $4B gross services volume, 832k active clients, $25B+ lifetime earnings, 53,110 learning completions, and $800K in grants

name: glide-brand-guidelines-2025
title: Glide Brand Guidelines 2025
description: Glide brand guidelines establishing brand identity across logo, color palette, imagery, tone of voice, and design system standards. The deck covers logo specifications, wordmark spacing rules, core and secondary colors, primary typefaces Chromatic Grotesque and Inter, photography and illustration style, and brand personality traits including confident, human, and intelligent positioning. Application examples demonstrate guidelines usage across digital and print materials

name: remodelling-the-internet-the-verge-2025
title: Remodelling the Internet: The Verge 2025
description: Talk presented by The Verge examining how digital communities are reshaping in the post-social, AI era. The deck argues that legacy platforms like Google and Facebook are losing user trust while people migrate to smaller, niche communities built on shared interests. It presents survey data from over 2,000 U.S. adults showing that 86% want smaller personal digital spaces, nearly 50% prefer communities without AI-generated content, and communities optimally serve 50-200 people for fostering genuine connection

name: perplexity-ads-pitch-deck-2024
title: Perplexity Ads Pitch Deck 2024
description: Advertiser pitch for Perplexity, an AI-powered answer engine and search alternative. The deck positions Perplexity as a next-generation search platform that synthesizes web information conversationally rather than returning lists of links. It argues that traditional search has dominated for two decades but faces disruption from conversational AI, presents Perplexity's differentiated product approach, and outlines advertising opportunities for brands to reach engaged, query-driven users

name: detroit-institute-of-arts-brand-guidelines
title: Detroit Institute of Arts Brand Guidelines
description: Brand guidelines for Detroit Institute of Arts define identity system across all museum communications. The system covers brand strategy positioning DIA as a neutral container, logo specifications with Neue Haas Grotesk, color palette with Charcoal Gesso Deep Red Dark Magenta Deep Green and Teal with hex codes, Cormorant Garamond and Neue Haas Grotesk typeface selection, modular grid system, and applications across print digital and environmental design

name: filmsupply-commercial-filmmaking-trend-report-2025
title: Filmsupply Commercial Filmmaking Trend Report 2025
description: Filmsupply releases its 2025 commercial filmmaking trends report identifying eight visual and production shifts reshaping the industry. The report covers unique camera perspectives, analog footage, documentary realism, bold color grading, textural landscapes, representation diversity, experimental movement, and high-quality footage licensing standards. Each trend includes case studies, characteristics, and strategic implications for commercial creators and production teams.

name: nike-fy22-impact-report-2022
title: Nike FY22 Impact Report 2022
description: Nike's fiscal 2022 corporate impact report detailing progress against environmental, social, and governance targets across four pillars: moving the world forward, people representation and inclusion, planet carbon and resource management, and play community investment. The report shows FY22 as Nike's second year tracking performance toward 2025 goals with measurable achievements in renewable energy, waste reduction, supplier labor standards, and diversity hiring

name: combo-employee-handbook-2025
title: Combo Employee Handbook 2025
description: Handbook for Combo, a NYC strategy and design agency, establishing culture, mission, and values. Covers structured onboarding from first day through month one, detailed career growth paths with mentorship across Client Services, Brand Strategy, and Design roles, annual review and peer feedback processes, workplace culture standards, benefits including 401k and family leave, and organizational structure

name: wix-q2-2023-quarterly-report
title: Wix Q2 2023 Quarterly Report
description: Q2 2023 earnings report from Wix covering 254 million total registered users, $1.2 billion in Creative Subscriptions annualized recurring revenue, and $2.8 billion in Q2'23 gross payment volume. The deck presents quarterly revenue, transaction and partner revenue, geographic expansion to 40% international, 5,000 employees, and 22 supported languages, plus profitability improvements through cost reduction and operational efficiency gains

name: making-life-multiplanetary-spacex-2016
title: Making Life Multiplanetary: SpaceX 2016
description: Elon Musk's keynote presentation at the 2016 International Astronautical Congress outlining SpaceX's vision for Mars colonization. The deck argues that becoming a multiplanetary civilization is essential for long-term human survival, then presents the Interplanetary Transport System design that reduces per-person Mars mission costs from $10 billion to roughly $200,000 through full rocket reusability and in-orbit refueling. Mars settlement is presented as achievable within the present decade through advances in rocket engineering and self-sustaining city infrastructure.

name: adobe-creative-cloud-for-teams-2025
title: Adobe Creative Cloud for Teams 2025
description: Marketing presentation created with It's Nice That highlighting Adobe Creative Cloud for teams as a collaboration platform. The deck focuses on three pillars: seamless file shareability enabling real-time team access, comprehensive visibility providing 360-degree oversight of creative assets and workflows, and scalability allowing teams to grow without workflow friction or creative compromise

name: andreas-maris-capabilities-deck-2025
title: Andreas Maris Capabilities Deck 2025
description: 9-slide capabilities deck from Andreas Maris covering visual identity design, digital product design, brand strategy, and art direction. Includes a portfolio case study with deliverables, a client collaboration methodology built on iterative design and stakeholder feedback, and a service overview spanning creative direction and visual communication.

name: unpack-25-the-trends-in-travel
title: Unpack '25: The Trends in Travel
description: Expedia Group trend report exploring how travelers are reshaping trips around intentional detours, longevity planning, food culture, fandom, flexible work, and AI-assisted discovery. Across the deck, the presentation connects consumer behavior shifts, booking signals, destination examples, and experience design opportunities to explain how travel planning, purchasing, and place marketing are evolving in 2025

name: space10-project-catalogue-2023
title: SPACE10 Project Catalogue 2023
description: Project exhibition catalogue from SPACE10, IKEA's research and design lab, presenting seven open-source design projects including Bee Home, Future Food Today, SolarVille, Spaces on Wheels, The Growroom, Tomorrow's Meatball, and Urban Village. The catalogue invites galleries and exhibitors to download and display projects locally while adhering to sustainability, accessibility, and diversity values

name: zapion-design-studios-agency-deck
title: Zapion Design Studios Agency Deck
description: Agency deck for Zapion Design Studios, a human-centric design studio founded in 2023 as a subsidiary of Code & Hue, with 12 years of combined legacy. The 22 slides cover three service categories: digital design (UX, SaaS, mobile apps, design systems), behavioural design (psychology-driven, nudge design), and branding. Case studies include Aperture LED lighting CRO redesign, Jawhara Jewellery e-commerce rebrand, and iWorkX manufacturing connector platform for 200+ partners. Studios in Kochi and Dubai.

name: refresh-studios-capabilities-deck-2024
title: Refresh Studios Capabilities Deck 2024
description: Refresh Studio's 2024 capabilities deck for a South African digital product design studio holding Level 1 B-BBEE status. The 32 slides cover UX research and design services, branding (positioning, visual identity, art direction, campaign development), a four-phase process (Strategy, Research, Design, Test), and case studies for Morvi MVP launch, GRM Group branding, and Shadow trading platform. Client portfolio includes Spotify, Standard Bank, Nestlé, DSTV, and Peugeot.

name: ourfamilywizard-brand-guidelines
title: OurFamilyWizard Brand Guidelines
description: Brand guidelines for OurFamilyWizard, a co-parenting platform, across 86 slides. Voice and tone attributes include empathetic, pragmatic, credible, realistically optimistic, and friendly-not-formal. Visual system covers logo variants, a defined color palette, typeface hierarchy, layered capsule brand elements, photography principles for diverse family imagery, iconography library, and UI components for product application.

name: dept-impact-report-2023
title: DEPT Impact Report 2023
description: DEPT's 2023 impact report for a 3,841-person global digital agency across 104 slides covering five pillars: employees, clients, community, environment, and governance. Highlights include pay equity analysis by role and gender, the DEPT Cares volunteer program, science-based carbon reduction targets, a digital ethics advisory panel, and quantified 2028 sustainability commitments. GRI, SASB, and TCFD frameworks are referenced throughout, with external audit verification.

name: diagram-pitch-deck-2022
title: Diagram Pitch Deck 2022
description: Investor pitch for Diagram, founder Jordan Singer's AI-powered Figma plugin platform. The 79-slide deck covers Automator (100+ drag-and-drop design automation actions) and Creative AI tools (Designer, Fig, and a GPT-3-powered image-to-layers converter). Addresses a $35B design technology market with 16,000+ waitlist designers. Seeks $2M at a $15M post-money valuation to hire engineers and build AI design assistants over an 18-month roadmap.

name: upwork-investor-day-report-2024
title: Upwork Investor Day Report 2024
description: Upwork's 2024 investor day presentation across 123 slides covering the $1.3 trillion global work market opportunity derived from 225 million remote knowledge workers. The deck details five strategic pillars: marketplace innovation, brand building, enterprise expansion (40% of Fortune 500 customers), hybrid team culture, and long-term financial targets of $1B+ revenue by 2025 at 80-85% gross margin. Cohort retention data and enterprise case studies from Microsoft and Flexera support the growth thesis.

name: beyond-trends-2024-report
title: Beyond Trends 2024 Report
description: Driftline's Beyond Trends 2024 report on digital empowerment for impact-driven businesses. The 32 slides identify three blockers holding back innovation: inauthentic positioning, inadequate impact measurement, and unintentional technology adoption. Structured across ways of thinking, doing, and moving forward, the report pairs each challenge with case studies and actionable frameworks for building accountable brands and measuring progress beyond standard analytics.

name: ace-tate-responsibility-report-2020
title: Ace & Tate Responsibility Report 2020
description: Ace & Tate's 2020 responsibility report documenting the B Corp-certified eyewear brand's progress across four pillars: Planet, Products, People, and Progress. The 49 slides cover ISO 14040/14044 lifecycle assessments, a revised net-zero target moved from 2030 to 2050 in line with Science Based Targets, supply chain social audits, and a multi-year emissions roadmap. Founder Mark de Lange opens with candid commentary on early environmental missteps and course corrections.

name: sonos-q2-2022-financial-summary
title: Sonos Q2 2022 Financial Summary
description: Sonos Q2 2022 investor presentation reporting record quarterly revenue of $399.8M, up 20% year-over-year, with gross margin of 44.8% and adjusted EBITDA of $46.9M. The 19 slides cover supply chain cost headwinds (gross margin down 300bps YoY), opex leverage targets, and FY2024 long-range targets of $2.5B revenue at 45-47% gross margin. Appendix includes GAAP reconciliation tables.

name: artsy-gallery-insights-2022-report
title: Artsy Gallery Insights 2022 Report
description: Artsy's 2022 gallery insights report surveying contemporary art sales, collector behavior, and gallery operations. The 27 slides cover revenue benchmarks by gallery size, collector demographic splits by region and age group, online sales penetration, art fair and auction performance, and NFT market data. Closes with strategic recommendations for galleries on digital adoption, collector engagement, and market positioning.

name: hulu-brand-guidelines-2024
title: Hulu Brand Guidelines 2024
description: Brand guidelines for Hulu covering 99 slides across the complete visual identity system. Sections document Hulu green as the signature primary color with Pantone, CMYK, RGB, and hex values, dark mode palette adaptations, WCAG accessibility contrast standards, logo variants with clearspace and misuse examples, a type system with scale hierarchy and web font optimization, an iconography system with filled and outline variants, photography and illustration style, a modular grid with responsive breakpoints, motion and animation easing specifications, a component pattern library including hero, card grid, side-by-side, testimonial, and full-width layouts, tone and voice guidelines, and a version changelog.

name: wetransfer-ideas-report-2022
title: WeTransfer Ideas Report 2022
description: Annual industry research from WeTransfer surveying 6,000 creative professionals across 80+ countries on success, motivation, compensation, and burnout. The 57 slides surface five key insights: 55% prioritize personal values over job opportunities but only 22% can afford to, 78% accept personal sacrifice as a career norm, 67% have experienced burnout (75% among agency staff), 60% earn income from social media, and 80% admit they don't understand NFTs. Six industry voices contribute perspectives from Olivia Lopez, Marty Bell, Chantée Joseph, Raven Smith, Marcus Collins, and Myra Nussbaum.

name: galaxy-q2-2023-report
title: Galaxy Q2 2023 Report
description: Quarterly cryptocurrency market research report from Galaxy covering Q2 2023 trends across 21 slides. Findings include Bitcoin and Ethereum price movements, institutional capital flows, DeFi total value locked, NFT trading volumes, altcoin and layer-2 performance, stablecoin reserve data, mining and staking profitability, regulatory policy impacts, and Web3 venture funding activity. The report closes with a market outlook, portfolio guidance, and research methodology notes.

name: burger-king-brand-guidelines-2024
title: Burger King Brand Guidelines 2024
description: Brand identity guidelines for Burger King authorized partners covering 129 slides across verbal and visual identity systems. Sections document tone of voice characteristics (approachable, confident, irreverent, authentic), primary and secondary color palettes with Pantone and CMYK values, logo variants with clearspace rules and prohibited uses, the custom Flame Bold typeface with size hierarchy and regional alternatives, a modular grid system, food and people photography standards, an icon library with stroke and grid specs, and legal compliance and asset management processes.

name: mckinley-studios-pitch-deck
title: McKinley Studios Pitch Deck
description: Partnership proposal for McKinley Studios, an integrated architecture and interior design firm with 25+ years of retail design experience, including a long-term partnership with Aritzia. The 46 slides contrast traditional multi-vendor retail rollouts against McKinley's single-studio model combining architecture, interior design, procurement, strategy, brand management, and art direction. The deck covers completed project portfolios, multi-location execution processes, cost and timeline savings, ROI analysis, and a tiered partnership engagement model.

name: the-shift-hospitality-edi-deck-2024
title: The Shift Hospitality EDI Deck 2024
description: Marketing deck for The Shift Hospitality, an EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) platform built for hotel operations and vendor management. The 16 slides cover how hotels eliminate manual data entry and disconnected vendor networks, the platform's real-time integration with hotel PMS systems, a case study showing vendor response times cut by 60%, tiered pricing by property count and transaction volume, and a product roadmap including mobile vendor management and AI-powered insights.

name: mindset-studios-capabilities-deck-2024
title: Mindset Studios Capabilities Deck 2024
description: Capabilities deck for Mindset Studios, a creative studio offering strategic research, brand identity design, digital product development, and front-end engineering. The 12 slides cover service offerings, portfolio case studies with documented business outcomes, team expertise, flexible engagement models, and a research-informed collaboration process for design and digital transformation projects.

name: reflektor-webar-marketing-guide-2024
title: Reflektor WebAR Marketing Guide 2024
description: Marketing guide from Reflektor, a Toronto-based digital agency, explaining WebAR (Web-based Augmented Reality) for brands seeking interactive mobile experiences without requiring app downloads. The 28 slides cover what WebAR is, why it lifts engagement versus static content, analytics and conversion tracking, use cases in retail virtual try-on, beauty, fashion, and furniture visualization, and Reflektor's full-service packages covering creation, integration, analytics, and optimization.

name: widelabs-brand-guidelines-2017
title: Widelabs Brand Guidelines 2017
description: Brand guidebook for Widelabs, a design-driven agency founded in 2017 and specializing in UI/UX, branding, and marketing. The 50 slides document logo construction rules and protective field specifications, Sequel Sans typeface families with a proportional size scale, primary purple and accent yellow color palette with hex and RGB values, photography and illustration direction, an icon grid and library, motion easing and timing specifications, a modular grid system, and client case studies including a project representing 300 designed products.

name: superlist-pitch-deck-2023
title: Superlist Pitch Deck 2023
description: Investor pitch for Superlist, a task and project management platform built for remote and distributed teams. The 12 slides argue that while communication, meetings, and knowledge management were all disrupted by modern tools, task management stayed static,leaving 90% of employees reporting shortcomings in their current tools. Superlist consolidates all workflow dimensions into one workspace to address a $50B productivity market, with the task and project management segment valued at $4B and growing. Competitors Asana, Monday.com, Jira, and Planio are cited as too complex and lacking personal workflow integration.

name: mash-brand-guidelines-2023
title: Mash Brand Guidelines 2023
description: Brand guidelines for Mash, a creator monetization platform built on the mission to remonetize the internet. The 62 slides cover brand strategy with three pillars (Find Your Fit, Power to People, Build for Tomorrow), a logo system with full wordmark and graphic mark variants, a magenta-led color palette with RGB and CMYK specifications, Rules and GT Flexa typefaces with an 8-divisible type scale, energetic illustration direction, and application mockups across web, mobile, social, and print touchpoints.

name: panel-investor-pitch-deck-2023
title: Panel Investor Pitch Deck 2023
description: Investor pitch for Panel, a two-sided marketplace connecting 50M+ content creators with performance-based advertiser campaigns. The 20 slides cover the monetization gap facing creators, Panel's proprietary engagement strategies and CPM-based campaign model, partnerships with Disney, Hasbro, Amazon, Walmart, Snapchat, TikTok, and YouTube, a 29.3% CAGR market opportunity, and a $1.5M seed raise to hire key leadership and reach profitability within 24 months. The business model shows a $50K campaign yielding 50% gross profit margin.

name: yuga-labs-pitch-deck-2023
title: Yuga Labs Pitch Deck 2023
description: Investor pitch for Yuga Labs, the web3 company behind Bored Ape Yacht Club (BAYC). The 13 slides cover Yuga's thesis that NFTs function as digital identity infrastructure, BAYC's community metrics and membership benefits, the Otherside metaverse expansion plan, revenue streams from NFT sales and licensing, token economics, and a multi-phase roadmap for ecosystem scaling. The deck frames Yuga as the dominant player in web3 narrative and creator economy infrastructure.

name: wwdc-23-keynote-product-highlights
title: WWDC 23 Keynote Product Highlights
description: Product highlights from Apple's WWDC 2023 developer conference covering watchOS, iPadOS, macOS Ventura, and M2 Ultra hardware. The 8 slides include topographic maps and mental health monitoring in watchOS, interactive widgets and offline maps in iPadOS, locked private browsing and desktop widgets in macOS Ventura, and M2 Ultra specs of 24-core CPU, 76-core GPU, 192 GB unified memory, and 800 GB/s memory bandwidth. Mac Studio connectivity covers Thunderbolt 4, 8K display output, Wi-Fi 6E, and up to 8 TB storage.

name: wwdc-22-keynote-product-highlights
title: WWDC 22 Keynote Product Highlights
description: Product highlights from Apple's WWDC 2022 developer conference covering watchOS, iPadOS, iOS 16, and the M2 chip. The 7 marketing slides detail AFib history notifications and sleep tracking in watchOS, Stage Manager window management in iPadOS, customizable lock screens and live activities in iOS 16, and the M2 chip delivering 15.8 trillion operations per second with a 40% faster neural engine. MacBook Pro specs include up to 24 GB unified memory, 2 TB SSD, 20-hour battery life, and 100% recycled aluminum casing.

name: wayray-pitch-deck-2023
title: WayRay Pitch Deck 2023
description: Investor pitch for WayRay, a holographic AR display company targeting automotive and built-environment markets. The 28 slides cover WayRay's holographic head-up display technology, which achieves a 12+ degree field of view in a 3-liter package compared to 18–22 liters for conventional HUDs, with unlimited virtual image distance that eliminates driver refocus. Technology details include the AR Rendering Engine, custom blue lasers, photopolymer holographic film, and proprietary PGU optics. The deck also presents a True AR marketplace for third-party content, expansion into trains and buildings, and a 230-person team with 64% in R&D.

name: verse-ai-pitch-deck
title: Verse AI Pitch Deck
description: Investor pitch for Verse, a software platform that automates clean power purchase agreements (PPAs) for organizations. The 5 slides establish that 98% of U.S. electricity demand cannot access direct clean power purchases, and the 2% that can relies on manual spreadsheet workflows costing up to $1M per 100 MW deal, dominated by four large tech companies. Verse replaces those spreadsheets with specialized software to open PPA markets to mid-sized buyers.

name: ux-research-report-template
title: UX Research Report Template
description: UX research report template by Hrvoje Grubisic built around a counterintuitive question: why encourage users to rely on a service less? The 6 slides walk through a four-step research process covering pain-point discovery, field observation, data synthesis, and actionable recommendations. Sample outputs include a user persona for Christina Mercado with a 12-touchpoint customer journey map and documentation of a collaborative analysis workshop.

name: smith-diction-process-deck-2023
title: Smith & Diction Process Deck 2023
description: Agency capabilities deck from Smith & Diction, a branding studio with 13 years of identity design experience. The 10 slides walk through a structured 10-step creative process from introductions and proposals through discovery, identity design, brandwork, client presentation, feedback, and file handoff. Featured client logo work illustrates the methodology, and a services summary covers branding, illustration, digital design, print design, packaging, art direction, and copywriting.

name: smalls-pitch-deck-2023
title: Smalls Pitch Deck 2023
description: Investor pitch for Smalls, a direct-to-consumer fresh cat food brand built for millennial pet owners who treat cats as family. The 24 slides document subscriber growth of 8x since 2020, 86% recurring revenue, 95% customer retention at the two-year mark, and a 10x manufacturing capacity increase after relocating facilities. The ask is $12.5M to double food marketing reach and expand into adjacent categories including cat accessories and services within a $33B total addressable market.

name: zapier-brand-guidelines-2023
title: Zapier Brand Guidelines 2023
description: Zapier brand guidelines covering vision, audience positioning, and design system for the automation platform serving small to mid-sized businesses. The 21 slides include belief statements, audience segmentation for automation accelerators, a 10-color palette (Orange, Earth, Moss, Night, Lavender, and five supporting tones), Inter and Degular Display font specifications, an iconography system with outline and filled variants, product interface examples, and a photography spectrum organized by Attract, Engage, and Retain campaign goals.

name: series-b-pitch-deck-template
title: Series B Pitch Deck Template
description: Series B pitch deck template with a 10-section framework for growth-stage fundraising. The 7 slides include problem quantification (93% market scale, 47% pain level, 85% dissatisfied with alternatives), a customer testimonial slide, target audience segmentation (80K enterprises, 1M team users, 2M individuals), and a five-year revenue projection from $1.8M to $36M ARR.

name: openai-brand-guidelines-2022
title: OpenAI Brand Guidelines 2022
description: Selected slides from OpenAI's 2022 brand guidelines, prepared by AREA 17, covering the company's mission to ensure AGI benefits humanity. The 17-slide selection documents five brand values (gravitas, precision, approachability, allure, boldness), a black-and-white primary palette with 30 color themes in light/mid/dark variants, Signifier and Söhne font specifications, mitered-cap iconography standards, photography principles, and data visualization frameworks.

name: studio-treble-portfolio-deck-2023
title: Studio Treble Portfolio Deck 2023
description: Portfolio deck from Studio Treble, a design agency specializing in pitch deck design and branding for startups. The 13 slides cover the agency's expertise in investor presentations, visual identity services including logo design and typeface selection, design process from discovery to execution, client case studies with testimonials, and engagement model for prospective clients.

name: olo-esg-report-2022
title: Olo ESG Report 2022
description: Olo's 2022 ESG report across 37 slides covering environmental impact, workplace culture, and governance. Carbon data spans three scopes: Scope 1 at 17-30 tCO2eq, Scope 2 at 101-151 tCO2eq, and Scope 3 upstream at up to 5,212 tCO2eq total. Diversity metrics break down gender and racial representation across leadership, tech, and non-tech roles. Closing disclosure index maps disclosures to GRI and SASB frameworks.

name: nietzsche-pitch-deck-2023
title: Nietzsche Pitch Deck 2023
description: Investor pitch deck for Nietzsche, an early-stage AI platform applying moral frameworks and hypothesis testing to improve project margins and interview program quality. The 11-slide deck opens with a Nietzsche-inspired challenge to unexamined AI assumptions, then covers three technical pillars: AI, data, and infrastructure. Traction slide reports 100+ users, $1M+ ARR, and $0 burn rate, making the case for a capital-efficient approach to AI ethics in enterprise workflows.

name: monzo-brand-style-guide-2022
title: Monzo Brand Style Guide 2022
description: Brand style guide for Monzo, the UK digital bank, released August 2022. The 82 slides cover the hot-coral-first logo system with M-icon variants, a primary palette of hot coral, soft white, and deep navy plus six secondary colors, two typefaces (Oldschool Grotesk for headlines, Monzo Sans for UI), art direction rules for authentic lifestyle photography, and product mockup standards for light and dark mode.

name: lunchbox-pitch-deck-2023
title: Lunchbox Pitch Deck 2023
description: Series B investor pitch for Lunchbox, a unified operating system for restaurants. The deck argues against two bad alternatives: third-party platforms like Uber Eats (expensive commissions, no customer data) and custom builds like SweetGreen ($10M/year to run). Lunchbox consolidates online ordering, CRM, and marketing in one tool. Traction: 49% first-party order growth within 6 months, $19.6M in commission fees saved, and brands including SAMS, Inday, and Mexicue.

name: linear-pitch-deck-2023
title: Linear Pitch Deck 2023
description: 2023 sales deck for Linear, pitching its issue tracker as the fast alternative to bloated tools like Jira. The 9 slides cover the problem of slow, cluttered software; Linear's sub-100ms performance and keyboard-first workflows; Git, Figma, Slack, and GitHub integrations; and customer stories from Cash App and Watershed. Over 5,000 companies, including Ramp, Loom, and Vercel, appear on the traction slide.

name: kpr-brand-guidelines-2023
title: KPR Brand Guidelines 2023
description: Brand guidelines for KPR, a worldbuilding project built around collective narratives and digital collectibles. The 31 slides cover the four-pointed symbol, wordmark variants, a core palette of black, white, and purple with eight extended colors, three-tier typeface system (ABC Whyte Inktrap, IBM Plex Mono, Hexaframe CF), computer-chip patterns, and sub-brand identities for Macro View, Animus, Prisma, and Boon.

name: frame-io-brand-style-guide-2023
title: Frame.io Brand Style Guide 2023
description: Brand guidelines for Frame.io, a video collaboration platform for creative professionals. The 18 slides cover brand principles (undeniable, premium, professional, cinematic), logo variants with clearspace specs, a primary palette of Cobalt, Electric, Iris, and Coral, cast-light photography technique, and gradient blending rules for campaign work.

name: fernand-pitch-deck-2023
title: Fernand Pitch Deck 2023
description: Investor pitch for Fernand, a support helpdesk built for SaaS teams. The tool loads under 100ms, puts every action on a keyboard shortcut, and integrates natively with Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle. Founded by Antoine Minoux (ex-Yelp) and Cyril Nicodème, both indie SaaS founders with 20+ combined years of experience. Pricing is $29 per active user monthly with no paywalls and no limits on conversations.

name: emma-capabilities-deck-2023
title: Emma Capabilities Deck 2023
description: Capabilities deck for Emma, a Lisbon-based visual identity studio. The deck walks through a four-phase design process (Define, Discover, Design, Deliver) running five weeks total, and presents three pricing tiers from €3,800 to €8,000. Portfolio work includes Recipes for Self-Love, Mulberry & Prince, and Aliene Lienea.

name: studio-freight-capabilities-deck-2023
title: Studio Freight Capabilities Deck 2023
description: Capabilities deck for Studio Freight, an independent creative studio working across brand design, product design, and web design. Six full case studies cover Easol, Republic, Lunchbox, Evmos, Stord, and Bad Boys, each walking through the brief, strategic direction, visual system, and results. The studio's process combines strategic thinking with hands-on craft across fintech, crypto, logistics, and lifestyle sectors.

name: block-bitcoin-knowledge-and-perceptions-report-2023
title: Block Bitcoin Knowledge and Perceptions Report 2023
description: Block's 2023 research report on Bitcoin knowledge and perceptions across demographics and geographies. The 19 slides map public understanding of decentralization, mining, and self-custody; track sentiment gaps between institutional investors and retail participants; and identify the biggest adoption barriers: security concerns, price volatility, and regulatory uncertainty. Strategic recommendations close the report.

name: apple-event-product-summary-2023
title: Apple Event Product Summary 2023
description: Bento-grid marketing slides from Apple's September 2023 keynote, covering iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15, and Watch Series 9. Highlights include 48MP cameras with photonic engine, A17 Pro in titanium, USB-C across the line, and the S9 chip driving 2000-nit brightness in the new Watch.

name: apple-event-product-summary-2022
title: Apple Event Product Summary 2022
description: Bento-grid marketing slides from Apple's September 2022 keynote, covering AirPods Pro with H2 chip, Watch Series 8, Watch Ultra, and iPhone 14 Pro. Key specs include 2x active noise cancellation, 60-hour Ultra battery, 48MP photonic camera with Dynamic Island, and a 2030 carbon-neutral commitment backed by 100% recycled rare earth elements.

name: design-trends-to-live-and-die-for-2020
title: Design Trends To Live And Die For 2020
description: Conference slides from Claudio Guglieri's 2020 design trends talk, originally delivered at Awwwards. The 14 slides cover creativity myths, systematic innovation methods, type and color directions gaining traction that year, and how Guglieri expects digital product and motion design practice to shift. Strong visual presentation with Guglieri's characteristic editorial typography.

name: arkive-pitch-deck-2022
title: Arkive Pitch Deck 2022
description: Investor pitch for Arkive, a decentralized physical museum where NFT members collectively acquire, curate, and exhibit real-world art and cultural artifacts. The deck argues that traditional museums lock away 99% of collections and consolidate curatorial power, then presents Arkive's flywheel model linking NFT membership fees to art acquisitions and global exhibitions. Market data positions curated art collections as returning 24% annually, outpacing the S&P 500, while crypto market growth of 2700% since 2017 creates a convergence opportunity

name: palantir-q1-business-update-2023
title: Palantir Q1 Business Update 2023
description: Q1 2023 earnings deck from Palantir, covering the company's first GAAP operating profitability quarter and second consecutive quarter of GAAP net income. Revenue hit $525M, up 18% year-over-year. US commercial revenue grew 26% to $107M; total customer count jumped 41% to 391. The deck also introduces AIP, a new product layer that connects Foundry, Gotham, and third-party LLMs for enterprise and defense use cases.
